title.zh: 卷344 列傳一百三十一 勒保 额勒登保 胡时显 德楞泰
title.en: Volume 344 Biographies 131: Lei Bao, E Lei Deng Bao, Hu Shixian, De Leng Tai
title.raw: 卷344 列傳一百三十一 勒保 额勒登保 胡时显 德楞泰

sentences.zh: 勒保，字宜軒，費莫氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人，大學士溫福子。

translations.literal: Le Bao, styled Yixuan, of the Feimo clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner and a son of Grand Secretary Wen Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao, courtesy name Yixuan, belonged to the Feimo clan of the Bordered Red Banner; he was the son of Grand Secretary Wen Fu.

sentences.zh: 由中書科筆帖式充軍機章京。

translations.literal: Beginning as a clerk of the Secretariat Hanlin, he served as a Grand Council secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as a Hanlin Secretariat clerk and was appointed a Grand Council secretary.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十四年，出為歸化城理事同知。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Qianlong he went out as subprefect in charge of affairs at Guihua City.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 34 he was posted as the Guihua City subprefect in charge of local affairs.

sentences.zh: 坐事當褫職，高宗以溫福方徵金川，特原之。

translations.literal: For an offense he should have been dismissed, but the Gaozong Emperor, because Wen Fu was then campaigning in Jinchuan, specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: He was liable to dismissal for misconduct, but Emperor Gaozong spared him because Wen Fu was campaigning in Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 授兵部主事，仍直軍機處。

translations.literal: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of War and continued to serve at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was made a war secretary while remaining on duty at the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中，出為江西贛南道，調安徽廬鳳道。

translations.literal: Promoted repeatedly to director, he went out as Jiangxi Gannan circuit intendant and was transferred to Anhui Luzhou-Fengyang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After successive promotions to director he served as Gannan intendant in Jiangxi, then as Luzhou-Fengyang intendant in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 以母憂去官，命為庫倫辦事章京。

translations.literal: He left office on his mother's death and was appointed a clerk for affairs at Khuree.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned in mourning for his mother and was then named a Khuree affairs clerk.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，充辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was made commissioner for affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 45 he became commissioner for affairs.

sentences.zh: 累擢兵部侍郎，仍留庫倫。

translations.literal: Promoted repeatedly to vice minister of war, he remained at Khuree.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to vice minister of war while still stationed at Khuree.

sentences.zh: 五十年，內召。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year he was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 50 he was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，署陝甘總督，尋實授。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he acted as governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu and shortly received the substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In year 52 he acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, then received the full post.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，大軍徵廓爾喀，治西路駝馬、裝糧、台站，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, when the great army campaigned against Gurkha, he managed camels, horses, grain packing, and relay stations on the western route and was given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 56, during the Gurkha campaign, he handled camels, horses, grain transport, and relay stations on the western route and was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 初，安徽奸民劉松以習混元教戍甘肅，复倡白蓮教，與其黨湖北樊學明、齊林，陝西韓龍，四川謝添繡等謀不軌。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Anhui rascal Liu Song, banished to Gansu for practicing the Hunyuan sect, had revived the White Lotus teaching and with his partisans—Fan Xueming and Qi Lin of Hubei, Han Long of Shaanxi, Xie Tianxiu of Sichuan, and others—plotted sedition.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Liu Song of Anhui, exiled to Gansu for the Hunyuan sect, revived the White Lotus faith; with Fan Xueming and Qi Lin in Hubei, Han Long in Shaanxi, Xie Tianxiu in Sichuan, and others, he plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，勒保捕劉松誅之，而鬆黨劉之協、宋之清傳教於河南、安徽。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year Le Bao captured and executed Liu Song, but Song's followers Liu Zhixie and Song Zhiqing spread the teaching in Henan and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In year 59 Le Bao seized and executed Liu Song, yet Liu Zhixie and Song Zhiqing carried the doctrine into Henan and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 以鹿邑王氏子曰發生者，詭明裔硃姓，煽動愚民，事覺被捕。

translations.literal: A son of the Wang family of Luyi called Fasheng falsely claimed descent from the Ming house under the surname Zhu and stirred up the common people; when the plot was discovered he was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: A Luyi Wang clansman named Fasheng posed as a Zhu descendant of the Ming and incited the people; exposed, he was arrested.

sentences.zh: 詔誅首惡，赦餘黨，發生以童幼免死，戍新疆。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ringleaders executed and the rest pardoned; Fasheng, as a child, was spared death and banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The court executed the chief culprits and pardoned the rest; Fasheng, being young, was spared and sent to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 之協遠颺不獲，各省大索，官吏奉行不善，頗為民擾。

translations.literal: Zhixie fled far and could not be taken; provinces searched widely, and officials who carried out the orders badly greatly harassed the people.
translations.idiomatic: Zhixie escaped and eluded capture; empire-wide searches, badly run by local officials, became a serious nuisance to the people.

sentences.zh: 武昌府同知常丹葵在荊州、宜昌株連數千人，川、楚民方以苗事困軍興，無賴者又因禁私鹽、私鑄失業，益仇官，亂機四伏矣。

translations.literal: Chang Danqi, subprefect of Wuchang, implicated thousands at Jingzhou and Yichang; the people of Sichuan and Hubei were already strained by Miao campaigns and military levies, while idlers also lost livelihoods from bans on private salt and coining, grew hostile to officials, and signs of revolt lurked everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang subprefect Chang Danqi implicated thousands in Jingzhou and Yichang; Sichuan and Hubei were already burdened by Miao wars, and men ruined by bans on private salt and coining turned against the magistrates—unrest was brewing everywhere.

sentences.zh: 六十年，勒保調雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year Le Bao was transferred to be governor-general of Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 60 he was transferred to the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-generalship.

sentences.zh: 湖南、貴州苗疆不靖，福康安督師進討，勒保赴軍，安撫正大、銅仁、鎮遠降苗，並治軍需。

translations.literal: The Miao frontiers of Hunan and Guizhou were unsettled; Fuk'ang-an commanded the advance, and Le Bao joined the army to pacify surrendered Miao of Zhengda, Tongren, and Zhenyuan and to handle military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: With Hunan and Guizhou Miao borders in turmoil, Fuk'ang'an led the campaign; Le Bao joined him, pacified surrendering Miao in Zhengda, Tongren, and Zhenyuan, and managed supplies.

sentences.zh: 雲南威遠倮匪擾邊，勒保將赴剿，會倮匪即平，福康安、和琳相繼卒於軍，命偕明亮、鄂輝接辦軍務，未至，而湖北教匪熾，蔓延川、陝。

translations.literal: Lolo bandits at Weiyuan in Yunnan troubled the border; Le Bao was about to go suppress them when the Lolo disturbance ended. Fuk'ang'an and Helin died in succession at the front, and Le Bao was ordered with Mingliang and E'hui to take over the command before he arrived, while sect rebels in Hubei flared up and spread into Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyuan Lolo raiders in Yunnan drew him to campaign, but they were pacified first. Fuk'ang'an and Helin died in the field; he was ordered with Mingliang and E'hui to succeed them, but before he arrived Hubei sect rebels surged into Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 林之華、覃加耀踞長陽黃柏山，福寧攻之不克，勒保往會剿，嘉慶二年春，連戰敗之。

translations.literal: Lin Zhihua and Tan Jiayao held Huangbai Mountain in Changyang; Funing attacked without success, and Le Bao went to join the campaign. In spring of Jiaqing 2 he defeated them in successive battles.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Zhihua and Tan Jiayao held Huangbai Mountain in Changyang; after Funing failed, Le Bao joined the siege and in spring of Jiaqing 2 won a series of victories.

sentences.zh: 方乘勝薄其巢，而貴州南籠仲苗王囊仙等叛，詔勒保督師討之。

translations.literal: Just as he pressed the victory toward their lair, the Zhong Miao of Nalong in Guizhou rebelled under Wang Nangxian, and Le Bao was ordered to command the suppression.
translations.idiomatic: As he was closing on their stronghold, the Zhong Miao of Guizhou's Nalong rose under Wang Nangxian, and he was ordered to command against them.

sentences.zh: 王囊仙者，洞灑寨苗婦，當丈寨韋七綹須，以囊仙有幻術，推為首。

translations.literal: Wang Nangxian was a Miao woman of Dongsa stock, wife of Wei Qishuo of Dangzhai; because Nangxian was thought to have sorcery, they made her leader.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Nangxian was a Dongsa Miao woman married to Wei Qishuo of Dangzhai; credited with magic, she was made chief.

sentences.zh: 分遣其黨大王公、李阿六、王抱羊圍南籠府，及府屬之永豐、黃草壩、捧鮓、新城、冊亨，安順府屬之永寧、歸化諸城。

translations.literal: She sent her partisans the Great Duke Gong, Li A'liu, and Wang Baoyang to surround Nanlong prefecture and the cities Yongfeng, Huangcaoba, Pengzha, Xincheng, and Ceheng under it, and Yongning and Guihua under Anshun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: She sent the Great Duke Gong, Li A'liu, and Wang Baoyang to besiege Nanlong and its dependencies—Yongfeng, Huangcaoba, Pengzha, Xincheng, Ceheng—as well as Yongning and Guihua in Anshun.

sentences.zh: 冊亨陷，滇、黔道梗。

translations.literal: Ceheng fell and the Yunnan-Guizhou route was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Ceheng fell and traffic between Yunnan and Guizhou was cut.

sentences.zh: 三月，勒保至，令總兵德英額、札郎阿、袁敏分守東、西、北三路。

translations.literal: In the third month Le Bao arrived and ordered the commanders De Ying'e, Zhalang A, and Yuan Min to guard the eastern, western, and northern routes respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 Le Bao arrived and posted De Ying'e, Zhalang A, and Yuan Min on the east, west, and north.

sentences.zh: 其南際滇、粵，諮兩廣總督吉慶、雲南巡撫江蘭防之；

translations.literal: To the south, bordering Yunnan and Guangdong, he consulted Governors-General Ji Qing of Guangdong-Guangxi and Jiang Lan of Yunnan for defense;
translations.idiomatic: On the south, along the Yunnan and Guangdong border, he coordinated with Ji Qing and Yunnan governor Jiang Lan;

sentences.zh: 自率按察使常明、副將施縉，進克關嶺。

translations.literal: he himself led the provincial surveillance commissioner Chang Ming and deputy commander Shi Jin to advance and take Guanling.
translations.idiomatic: he himself led Chang Ming and Shi Jin to recover Guanling.

sentences.zh: 抵永寧，副將巴圖什裡已解其圍，都司周廷翰援歸化，圍亦解。

translations.literal: Reaching Yongning, he found Deputy Commander Batu Shili had already lifted the siege, and Major Zhou Tinghan had relieved Guihua as well.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongning, Batu Shili had already broken the siege; Zhou Tinghan had relieved Guihua too.

sentences.zh: 會提督珠隆阿擊永豐，自率總兵張玉龍、七格，解新城圍，進至南籠，圍始解。

translations.literal: Provincial Commander-in-Chief Zhulong A attacked Yongfeng; Le Bao himself led Zhang Yulong and Qige to relieve Xincheng, advanced to Nanlong, and the siege was finally raised.
translations.idiomatic: Zhulong A struck Yongfeng while Le Bao with Zhang Yulong and Qige relieved Xincheng, reached Nanlong, and ended the siege.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉南籠固守，賜名興義。

translations.literal: An edict praised Nanlong's steadfast defense and granted it the new name Xingyi.
translations.idiomatic: The throne commended Nanlong's defense and renamed it Xingyi.

sentences.zh: 遣常明、施縉解黃草壩圍。

translations.literal: He sent Chang Ming and Shi Jin to relieve Huangcaoba.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Chang Ming and Shi Jin to lift the Huangcaoba siege.

sentences.zh: 賊悉眾圍捧鮓、永豐益急，分兵援之，先解捧鮓圍，自率常明、施縉攻洞灑、當丈賊巢。

translations.literal: The rebels massed more fiercely around Pengzha and Yongfeng; he divided troops to aid them, first relieved Pengzha, then himself led Chang Ming and Shi Jin against the lairs at Dongsa and Dangzhai.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels tightened the sieges of Pengzha and Yongfeng; he detached reinforcements, freed Pengzha first, then led Chang Ming and Shi Jin against Dongsa and Dangzhai.

sentences.zh: 賊縱火自焚，都司王宏信、千總洪保玉冒烈焰入，擒王囊仙、韋七綹須，旋解永豐圍。

translations.literal: The rebels set fires and burned themselves; Major Wang Hongxin and Captain Hong Baoyu rushed through the flames, seized Wang Nangxian and Wei Qishuo, and Yongfeng was soon relieved.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels torched themselves; Wang Hongxin and Hong Baoyu charged the flames, captured Wang Nangxian and Wei Qishuo, and Yongfeng was relieved.

sentences.zh: 吉慶亦自廣西至，复冊亨。

translations.literal: Ji Qing also came from Guangxi and recovered Ceheng.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Qing advanced from Guangxi and retook Ceheng.

sentences.zh: 六月，仲苗平，詔改永豐曰貞豐，錫封勒保一等侯爵，號曰威勤。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Zhong Miao were pacified; an edict changed Yongfeng to Zhenfeng, and Le Bao was enfeoffed as first-class marquis with the style Weiqin.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 the Zhong Miao were pacified; Yongfeng became Zhenfeng, and Le Bao received a first-class marquisate styled Weiqin.

sentences.zh: 九月，調湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he was transferred to be governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 he became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 時川、楚賊氛愈熾，立青、黃、藍、白、線等號，又設掌櫃、元帥、先鋒、總兵等偽稱。

translations.literal: By then rebel power in Sichuan and Hubei grew fiercer; they took designations of Green, Yellow, Blue, White, and Red bands, and also set up false titles such as steward, marshal, vanguard, and commander.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan and Hubei rebels now used Green, Yellow, Blue, White, and Red bands and bogus ranks—steward, marshal, vanguard, commander.

sentences.zh: 先命永保總統諸軍，易以惠齡，又易以宜綿，皆不辦；

translations.literal: First Yong Bao was made overall commander of the armies, then replaced by Hui Ling, then by Yi Mian—none could manage the task;
translations.idiomatic: Yong Bao was first made supreme commander, then Hui Ling, then Yi Mian—none succeeded;

sentences.zh: 至是宜綿薦勒保以自代，允之。

translations.literal: now Yi Mian recommended Le Bao to replace himself, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: at last Yi Mian recommended Le Bao as his successor, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，至四川梁山，賊曾柳起石壩山，而白號王三槐、青號徐天德、藍號林亮工諸賊聚開縣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Le Bao reached Liangshan in Sichuan; the rebel Zeng Liu held Shibashan, while the White-band Wang Sanhuai, Green-band Xu Tiande, and Blue-band Lin Lianggong gathered at Kaixian.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 3 he reached Liangshan; Zeng Liu held Shibashan while Wang Sanhuai (White), Xu Tiande (Green), and Lin Lianggong (Blue) massed at Kaixian.

sentences.zh: 勒保先破石壩山，斬曾柳，詔嘉為入川第一功。

translations.literal: Le Bao first broke Shibashan and beheaded Zeng Liu; an edict praised this as the first merit on entering Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He first stormed Shibashan and killed Zeng Liu—the court hailed it as his first Sichuan victory.

sentences.zh: 調授四川總督。

translations.literal: He was transferred and appointed Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三槐走達州，與藍號冉文儔合，惟亮工仍在開縣之開州坪，勒保令副都統六十七、總兵富森布剿之；

translations.literal: Sanhuai fled to Dazhou and joined the Blue-band Ran Wencong, while only Lianggong remained at Kaizhouping in Kaixian; Le Bao ordered the deputy banner commander Liushiqi and Commander Fusenbu to suppress him;
translations.idiomatic: Sanhuai fled to Dazhou to join Ran Wencong (Blue); Lin Lianggong stayed at Kaizhouping; Le Bao sent Liushiqi and Fusenbu against him;

sentences.zh: 親追三槐，九戰皆捷。

translations.literal: he himself pursued Sanhuai and won nine battles in succession.
translations.idiomatic: he personally pursued Sanhuai and won nine straight fights.

sentences.zh: 賊走巴州，掠閬中、蒼溪而西，追之急，復東入儀隴。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Bazhou, plundered Langzhong and Cangxi, then turned west; pressed hard, they re-entered Yilong from the east.
translations.idiomatic: They raided through Bazhou, Langzhong, and Cangxi westward, then doubled back into Yilong under pressure.

sentences.zh: 勒保以賊踪靡定，所至裹脅，乃畫堅壁清野策，令民依山險扎寨屯糧，團練鄉勇​​自衛。

translations.literal: Le Bao, seeing rebel tracks uncertain and people seized wherever they went, devised a policy of fortified villages and cleared countryside, ordering the people to build stockaded camps on mountain defiles, store grain, and train militia for self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: Finding rebels shifting unpredictably and dragging locals along, Le Bao ordered mountain stockades, stored grain, and trained militia—the fortified-village strategy.

sentences.zh: 賊由儀隴趨孫家梁，欲與白號羅其清合。

translations.literal: The rebels left Yilong for Sunjialiang intending to join the White-band Luo Qiqing.
translations.idiomatic: They left Yilong for Sunjialiang to link with Luo Qiqing's White band.

sentences.zh: 偕惠齡、恆瑞截剿，三槐南竄渠縣，文儔​​遁入其清寨。

translations.literal: With Hui Ling and Hengrui he intercepted them; Sanhuai fled south to Quxian and Wencong slipped into Qiqing's camp.
translations.idiomatic: With Hui Ling and Hengrui he intercepted them; Sanhuai fled to Quxian and Wencong into Qiqing's camp.

sentences.zh: 勒保留惠齡、恆瑞剿孫家梁，仍親躡三槐。

translations.literal: Le Bao left Hui Ling and Hengrui to suppress Sunjialiang and again personally pursued Sanhuai.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao left Hui Ling and Hengrui at Sunjialiang and again chased Sanhuai himself.

sentences.zh: 五月，三槐犯大竹，分竄梁山、墊江、新寧，東奔開縣，亮工出為犄角，擊走之，斬其黨林定相。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Sanhuai attacked Dazhu, split to Liangshan, Dianjiang, and Xining, then dashed east to Kaixian; Lianggong came out in support, was beaten off, and his partisan Lin Dingxiang was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Sanhuai struck Dazhu, scattered toward Liangshan, Dianjiang, and Xining, then raced to Kaixian; Lianggong's support force was routed and Lin Dingxiang killed.

sentences.zh: 天德來援，敗之，擒其黨張洪鈞，天德奔新寧。

translations.literal: Tiande came to aid them, was defeated, and his partisan Zhang Hongjun was captured; Tiande fled to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande's relief was beaten, Zhang Hongjun taken, and Tiande fled to Xining.

sentences.zh: 三槐與冷天祿踞雲陽安樂坪，進圍之。

translations.literal: Sanhuai and Leng Tianlu held Anleping in Yunyang, and Le Bao advanced to besiege them.
translations.idiomatic: Sanhuai and Leng Tianlu held Anleping in Yunyang; Le Bao closed in.

sentences.zh: 七月，誘三槐降，擒之，械送京師，詔晉封公爵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he induced Sanhuai to surrender, seized him, and sent him in the cangue to the capital; an edict advanced Le Bao to duke.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 he lured Sanhuai into surrender, captured him, and sent him to Beijing; Le Bao was raised to duke.

sentences.zh: 天祿盡有三槐之眾，負嵎抗拒，圍攻久不下；

translations.literal: Tianlu took over all Sanhuai's forces, held a strong position, and resisted; the siege long failed;
translations.idiomatic: Tianlu absorbed Sanhuai's host, held out stubbornly, and the siege dragged on;

sentences.zh: 黃號龍紹週、龔建、樊人傑來援，擊卻之。

translations.literal: the Yellow-band Long Shaozhou, Gong Jian, and Fan Renjie came to aid them and were driven off.
translations.idiomatic: Long Shaozhou, Gong Jian, and Fan Renjie (Yellow) came to relieve them and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 十月，天祿糧盡，詭請降，夜突營，大為所挫，尋走新寧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, with grain exhausted, Tianlu falsely asked to surrender, then at night stormed the camp and suffered a heavy defeat, soon fleeing to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, starving, Tianlu feigned surrender, night-attacked the camp, was crushed, and fled to Xining.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，天德為額勒登保所敗，亦竄新寧仁市鋪，與黃號王光祖合。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Tiande was defeated by Eledengbao and also fled to Renshipu in Xining to join the Yellow-band Wang Guangzu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 4 Eledengbao beat Tiande, who fled to Renshipu in Xining to join Wang Guangzu (Yellow).

sentences.zh: 偕額勒登保夾擊，天德走墊江，天祿走忠州。

translations.literal: Le Bao and Eledengbao attacked from both sides; Tiande fled to Dianjiang and Tianlu to Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao and Eledengbao struck together; Tiande ran to Dianjiang and Tianlu to Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 勒保令額勒登保截擊天德，總兵百祥追天祿，自率大軍策應。

translations.literal: Le Bao ordered Eledengbao to intercept Tiande, Commander Bai Xiang to pursue Tianlu, and himself led the main force in support.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao sent Eledengbao after Tiande, Bai Xiang after Tianlu, and led the main army in support.

sentences.zh: 仁宗以前此諸軍事權不一，特授勒保經略大臣，節制川、楚、陝、甘、豫五省軍務，明亮、額勒登保為參贊。

translations.literal: The Renzong Emperor, because military authority had previously been divided, specially appointed Le Bao supreme commander with control over military affairs in Sichuan, Hubei, Shaanxi, Gansu, and Henan, with Mingliang and Eledengbao as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong, noting divided command, made Le Bao supreme commander over Sichuan, Hubei, Shaanxi, Gansu, and Henan, with Mingliang and Eledengbao as deputies.

sentences.zh: 勒保以賊勢重在四川，請暫駐梁山、大竹等處督師。

translations.literal: Le Bao, holding rebel strength centered in Sichuan, asked to remain temporarily at Liangshan, Dazhu, and other places to direct operations.
translations.idiomatic: Judging Sichuan the main theater, he asked to stay at Liangshan and Dazhu to direct the war.

sentences.zh: 尋破天德，天祿分竄鄰水、長壽，复敗之，天祿為額勒登保所殲。

translations.literal: Soon Tiande was broken, Tianlu split to Linshui and Changshou and was again defeated; Tianlu was destroyed by Eledengbao.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande was soon broken; Tianlu split toward Linshui and Changshou, was beaten again, and Eledengbao destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 二月，移駐達州。

translations.literal: In the second month he moved headquarters to Dazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 he shifted his headquarters to Dazhou.

sentences.zh: 疏言扎寨團練，行之四川有效，請通行於湖北、陝西、河南；

translations.literal: In a memorial he said stockades and militia training had proved effective in Sichuan and asked that they be applied in Hubei, Shaanxi, and Henan;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that stockades and militia had worked in Sichuan and should extend to Hubei, Shaanxi, and Henan;

sentences.zh: 又言安民即以散賊，請各省被賊之區，蠲免今歲應徵錢糧：並如議行。

translations.literal: he also said pacifying the people would scatter the rebels and asked that grain taxes due this year be remitted in every province touched by the rebels: both proposals were approved.
translations.idiomatic: he also urged remitting this year's taxes in ravaged districts to win the people and starve the rebels—both requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 四月，追剿天德、紹週、建、人傑及張子聰等，賊遁開縣東鄉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he pursued Tiande, Shaozhou, Jian, Renjie, and Zhang Zicong; the rebels fled to Dongxiang in Kaixian.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 he pursued Tiande, Shaozhou, Jian, Renjie, and Zhang Zicong to Kaixian's Dongxiang.

sentences.zh: 旋分竄竹峪關、渡口場，意圖入陝。

translations.literal: They soon split toward Zhuyuguan and Dukouchang, intending to enter Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: They then split toward Zhuyuguan and Dukouchang, aiming for Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 五月，子聰勾合藍號冉天元北竄，遣額勒登保兜擊，逼回川境。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Zicong joined the Blue-band Ran Tianyuan in a northward thrust; Le Bao sent Eledengbao to head them off and drive them back into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Zicong and Ran Tianyuan (Blue) thrust north; Eledengbao turned them back into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 子聰竄通江，藍號包正洪竄雲陽，青號王登廷竄東鄉，天德、紹週、建、人傑及線號龔文玉，白號張天倫竄大寧老林，勒保檄調諸軍分剿。

translations.literal: Zicong fled to Tongjiang, the Blue-band Bao Zhenghong to Yunyang, the Green-band Wang Dengting to Dongxiang, while Tiande, Shaozhou, Jian, Renjie, the Red-band Gong Wenyu, and the White-band Zhang Tianlun fled to the great forest of Daning; Le Bao ordered the armies to pursue them separately.
translations.idiomatic: Zicong went to Tongjiang, Bao Zhenghong (Blue) to Yunyang, Wang Dengting (Green) to Dongxiang; Tiande, Shaozhou, Jian, Renjie, Gong Wenyu (Red), and Zhang Tianlun (White) hid in Daning's great forest—Le Bao divided the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 六月，總兵硃射鬥殲正洪於雲陽；

translations.literal: In the sixth month Commander Zhu Shedou destroyed Zhenghong at Yunyang;
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 Zhu Shedou killed Zhenghong at Yunyang;

sentences.zh: 七月，德楞泰擒文玉於大寧；

translations.literal: in the seventh month Delengtai captured Wenyu at Daning;
translations.idiomatic: in month 7 Delengtai took Wenyu in Daning;

sentences.zh: 八月，提督七十五擒建、人傑於開縣：賊勢浸衰矣。

translations.literal: in the eighth month Provincial Commander-in-Chief Qishiwu captured Jian and Renjie at Kaixian: rebel power gradually waned.
translations.idiomatic: in month 8 Qishiwu seized Jian and Renjie at Kaixian—the rebels were ebbing.

sentences.zh: 會治餉大臣福寧劾勒保月餉十二萬兩，視他路為多，所辦賊有增無減；

translations.literal: Then Commissary Funing impeached Le Bao for monthly pay of 120,000 taels, more than other routes, while rebels under his command only increased;
translations.idiomatic: Then Funing, the commissary, accused Le Bao of drawing 120,000 taels a month—more than other fronts—while rebels only multiplied;

sentences.zh: 而天德復由大寧闌入湖北境，總督倭什布飛章告警。

translations.literal: and Tiande again crossed from Daning into Hubei, and Governor-General Wo-shi-bu sent urgent alarms.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande again slipped from Daning into Hubei, and Governor Wo-shi-bu alarmed the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔褫職，命尚書魁倫赴川勘問，以額勒登保代為經略。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Le Bao of office, ordered Minister Kuilun to Sichuan to investigate, and made Eledengbao supreme commander in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao was dismissed; Kuilun was sent to investigate; Eledengbao replaced him as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 勒保能得軍心，而八旗兵素驕，稍裁抑之，遂騰蜚語，及就逮，所部將士為之訟冤。

translations.literal: Le Bao had won the soldiers' hearts, but the Eight Banner troops were habitually arrogant; when he restrained them slightly, slander spread, and at his arrest the officers and men petitioned for his innocence.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao was loved by the ranks, but he curbed arrogant Banner troops; rumors spread, and when he was arrested his officers pleaded for him.

sentences.zh: 魁倫窺帝怒不測，未以上聞，稍為申辨糜餉縱賊罪，卒坐以明亮、恆瑞不聽調度；

translations.literal: Kuilun, seeing the Emperor's anger unpredictable, did not report this upward and only slightly argued the charges of wasting pay and indulging rebels; in the end he was condemned because Mingliang and Hengrui would not obey orders;
translations.idiomatic: Kuilun, fearing the Emperor's mood, withheld the petitions and lightly defended the waste-and-negligence charges; Le Bao was finally blamed because Mingliang and Hengrui disobeyed orders;

sentences.zh: 副都統訥音兵譁閧，不據實參奏；

translations.literal: Deputy Banner Commander Ne'yin had troops riot and did not memorialize truthfully;
translations.idiomatic: Ne'yin's troops mutinied and he failed to report it honestly;

sentences.zh: 又賊犯楚境不即馳報，玩視軍務，論大辟。

translations.literal: and when rebels entered Hubei he did not report at once, treating military affairs lightly—punishable by death.
translations.idiomatic: and he delayed reporting rebels in Hubei—capital crime.

sentences.zh: 帝念前功，改為斬監候，解部監禁。

translations.literal: The Emperor, mindful of past merit, changed the sentence to imprisonment awaiting execution and had him confined in the ministry prisons.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of earlier service, the Emperor commuted to imprisonment awaiting execution in the ministry jails.

sentences.zh: 五年春，額勒登保等勦賊陝西，魁倫專任川事，而將士不用命。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifth year Eledengbao and others suppressed rebels in Shaanxi; Kuilun alone handled Sichuan affairs, but officers and men would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 5 Eledengbao fought in Shaanxi while Kuilun held Sichuan, yet the troops would not obey.

sentences.zh: 天元、子聰合黃號徐萬富、青號汪瀛、線號陳得俸，渡嘉陵江，魁倫退守潼河，事聞，起勒保赴川。

translations.literal: Tianyuan and Zicong joined the Yellow-band Xu Wanfu, Green-band Wang Ying, and Red-band Chen Defu, crossed the Jialing, and Kuilun fell back to the Tong River; on report Le Bao was recalled to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyuan and Zicong united Xu Wanfu (Yellow), Wang Ying (Green), and Chen Defu (Red), crossed the Jialing, and Kuilun retreated to the Tong—Le Bao was summoned back.

sentences.zh: 三月至，賊已越潼河，赴中江截剿，連敗之，詔逮魁倫，授勒保四川提督，兼署總督。

translations.literal: He arrived in the third month; the rebels had already crossed the Tong; he intercepted them at Zhongjiang, defeated them repeatedly, and an edict arrested Kuilun and appointed Le Bao Sichuan provincial commander-in-chief acting also as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 he reached Sichuan after the rebels crossed the Tong; at Zhongjiang he beat them repeatedly; Kuilun was arrested and Le Bao made provincial commander-in-chief acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 時德楞泰已大破賊於馬蹄岡，冉天元、陳得俸、雷世旺先後殄滅；

translations.literal: By then Delengtai had already crushed the rebels at Matigang; Ran Tianyuan, Chen Defu, and Lei Shiwang were successively destroyed;
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai had already won at Matigang; Tianyuan, Defu, and Shiwang were gone;

sentences.zh: 合剿汪瀛於嘉陵江口，擒之。

translations.literal: joint operations at the Jialing mouth captured Wang Ying.
translations.idiomatic: a combined strike at the Jialing mouth took Wang Ying.

sentences.zh: 四月，擊敗高天升、馬學禮，賊遁甘肅番境，五月，复犯龍安，罷提督，專任總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he defeated Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli; the rebels fled into Gansu tribal territory, and in the fifth month when they again raided Long'an he was removed as provincial commander and held only the governor-generalship.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 he beat Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli; they fled into Gansu tribal lands; after a Long'an raid in month 5 he kept only the governor-generalship.

sentences.zh: 六月，賊北走甘肅，遣副都統阿哈保追之，自率兵剿川東、川北諸賊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the rebels went north into Gansu; he sent Deputy Banner Commander Ahabao in pursuit and himself led troops against the eastern and northern Sichuan rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 rebels entered Gansu; Ahabao pursued while he cleared eastern and northern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 七月，與德楞泰合擊白號苟文明、鮮大川於岳池新場，敗之，大川走死，實授總督。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he and Delengtai jointly attacked the White-band Gou Wenming and Xian Dachuan at Xinchang in Yuechi, defeated them, and Dachuan fled to his death; he received the substantive governor-general appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 he and Delengtai beat Gou Wenming and Xian Dachuan at Yuechi's Xinchang; Dachuan died fleeing; Le Bao received full governor-general rank.

sentences.zh: 八月，白號賊與青號趙麻花合，進擊，殲其黨湯思舉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month White-band rebels joined the Green-band Zhao Mahua; he advanced and destroyed their partisan Tang Siju.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 White rebels joined Zhao Mahua (Green); he advanced and killed Tang Siju.

sentences.zh: 麻花復合王珊向陝境，欲迎天德入川。

translations.literal: Mahua again joined Wang Shan toward Shaanxi, intending to welcome Tiande back into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Mahua and Wang Shan then moved toward Shaanxi to bring Tiande back into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 勒保截之於江口，斃麻花，珊亦為德楞泰所誅。

translations.literal: Le Bao intercepted them at Jiangkou, killed Mahua, and Shan was also executed by Delengtai.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao blocked them at Jiangkou, killed Mahua, and Delengtai executed Shan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，藍號李彬、白號楊開第、黃號齊國謨自巴州竄儀隴，德楞泰擊斃國謨，勒保亦斬開第，獨彬遁走。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Blue-band Li Bin, White-band Yang Kaidi, and Yellow-band Qi Guomo fled from Bazhou to Yilong; Delengtai killed Guomo and Le Bao beheaded Kaidi, while Bin alone escaped.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 Li Bin (Blue), Yang Kaidi (White), and Qi Guomo (Yellow) fled Bazhou toward Yilong; Delengtai killed Guomo, Le Bao Kaidi—only Bin escaped.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，移師川東，敗藍號楊步青於大寧，而樊人傑、徐萬富合藍號王士虎、冉天士擾廣元、蒼溪。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year he shifted to eastern Sichuan, defeated the Blue-band Yang Buqing at Daning, while Fan Renjie and Xu Wanfu with the Blue-bands Wang Shihu and Ran Tianshi harassed Guangyuan and Cangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 6 he moved east, beat Yang Buqing (Blue) at Daning; Fan Renjie and Xu Wanfu with Wang Shihu and Ran Tianshi (Blue) raided Guangyuan and Cangxi.

sentences.zh: 遣阿哈保往援，賊偽向儀隴，陰沿嘉陵江南下，欲潛渡；

translations.literal: He sent Ahabao to aid; the rebels feigned toward Yilong while secretly moving south along the Jialing to cross by stealth;
translations.idiomatic: He sent Ahabao; they feigned on Yilong while slipping south along the Jialing to ford secretly;

sentences.zh: 馳至南部與阿哈保合擊，殲萬富。

translations.literal: he raced to Nanbu and with Ahabao jointly attacked and destroyed Wanfu.
translations.idiomatic: he rushed to Nanbu, joined Ahabao, and destroyed Wanfu.

sentences.zh: 二月，藍號張士龍竄巴州，遣七十五擊斬之；

translations.literal: In the second month the Blue-band Zhang Shilong fled to Bazhou; he sent Qishiwu to strike and kill him;
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 Zhang Shilong (Blue) fled to Bazhou; Qishiwu hunted and killed him;

sentences.zh: 自擊藍號陳朝觀、白號魏學盛，敗之巫山、雲陽間。

translations.literal: he himself attacked the Blue-band Chen Chaoguan and White-band Wei Xuesheng and defeated them between Wushan and Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: he himself routed Chen Chaoguan (Blue) and Wei Xuesheng (White) between Wushan and Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 賊北竄入陝、楚界，追至竹山。

translations.literal: The rebels fled north into the Shaanxi-Hubei border and were pursued to Zhushan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels slipped north into the Shaanxi-Hubei borderlands and were chased to Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 六月，賊回竄東鄉，擊敗之，擒青號何子魁，殲藍號苟文明、鮮俸先。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the rebels doubled back to Dongxiang; he defeated them, captured the Green-band He Zikui, and destroyed the Blue-band Gou Wenming and Xian Fengxian.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 they doubled back to Dongxiang; he beat them, took He Zikui of the Green band, and wiped out Gou Wenming and Xian Fengxian of the Blue band.

sentences.zh: 七月，又擒徐天壽、王登高。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he again captured Xu Tianshou and Wang Dengting.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 he also seized Xu Tianshou and Wang Dengting.

sentences.zh: 八月，白號高見奇合魏學盛竄廣元，邀擊之，追至通江。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the White-band Gao Jianqi joined Wei Xuesheng in fleeing to Guangyuan; he intercepted them and pursued to Tongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 Gao Jianqi of the White band fled to Guangyuan with Wei Xuesheng; Le Bao intercepted and chased them to Tongjiang.

sentences.zh: 適藍號冉學勝自老林至與合，乘夜攻之，擒學勝。

translations.literal: Just then the Blue-band Ran Xuesheng came from the great forest to join them; he attacked by night and captured Xuesheng.
translations.idiomatic: Ran Xuesheng of the Blue band arrived from the great forest; a night attack took him.

sentences.zh: 詔封三等男。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed him as third-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: The court made him a third-class baron.

sentences.zh: 九月，見奇、學盛分竄南江及陝西西鄉。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Jianqi and Xuesheng split, fleeing to Nanjiang and Xixiang in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 Jianqi and Xuesheng split toward Nanjiang and Shaanxi's Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 勒保抵南江，聞李彬方掠巴州、蒼溪，恐逾嘉陵江，亟往，賊已東竄通江；

translations.literal: Le Bao reached Nanjiang and heard Li Bin was plundering Bazhou and Cangxi; fearing they would cross the Jialing, he hurried there, but the rebels had already fled east to Tongjiang;
translations.idiomatic: At Nanjiang he learned Li Bin was raiding Bazhou and Cangxi and rushed to block a Jialing crossing—the rebels had already fled east to Tongjiang;

sentences.zh: 乃移兵大竹，剿湯思蛟、劉朝選，追至太平，擒其黨蕭焜。

translations.literal: he then shifted troops to Dazhu to suppress Tang Sijiao and Liu Chaoxuan, pursued to Taiping, and captured their partisan Xiao Kun.
translations.idiomatic: he moved on Dazhu against Tang Sijiao and Liu Chaoxuan, pursued to Taiping, and seized Xiao Kun.

sentences.zh: 是冬，偕額勒登保、德楞泰疏言：「剿匪大局已定，請酌撤官兵。」

translations.literal: That winter, with Eledengbao and Delengtai, he memorialized: "The overall suppression of bandits is settled; please consider reducing the regular troops."
translations.idiomatic: That winter he joined Eledengbao and Delengtai in urging: "The rebellion is essentially won—trim the regular armies."

sentences.zh: 詔以「巨賊未盡除，遽思將就了事」，嚴斥之。

translations.literal: An edict replied that "great bandits are not yet wholly eliminated, yet you hasten to treat the matter as nearly finished" and sharply rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: The throne retorted that major chiefs remained and rebuked them for trying to wind the war up too soon.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，复疏言：「川省自築寨練團，賊勢十去其九。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year he again memorialized: "Since Sichuan built stockades and trained militia, rebel strength has dwindled to a tenth.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 7 he argued that stockades and militia had reduced rebel power in Sichuan by nine tenths.

sentences.zh: 擬分段駐兵，率團協力搜捕餘匪；

translations.literal: He proposed stationing troops by sector and leading the militia in joint searches for remnant bandits;
translations.idiomatic: He proposed sector garrisons and militia sweeps for stragglers;

sentences.zh: 遣熟諳軍事之道、府，正、佐各員，分專責成。

translations.literal: and sending circuit, prefectural, and assistant officials versed in military affairs, each with a fixed charge.
translations.idiomatic: and assigning experienced circuit and prefectural officers to defined responsibilities.

sentences.zh: 兵力所不到，民力助之；

translations.literal: Where troops could not reach, civilian strength would assist;
translations.idiomatic: Where the army could not go, the people would help;

sentences.zh: 民力所不支，兵力助之：庶賊無所匿。」

translations.literal: where civilian strength could not sustain the effort, troops would assist—so that bandits would have nowhere to hide."
translations.idiomatic: where the people could not hold, troops would step in—leaving the rebels no refuge.

sentences.zh: 詔如議行。

translations.literal: An edict approved and ordered this carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 是月，擒青號何讚於忠州。

translations.literal: That month he captured the Green-band He Zan at Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month he took He Zan of the Green band at Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月，李彬竄南江，為建昌道劉清所擒。

translations.literal: In the second month Li Bin fled to Nanjiang and was captured by Jianda circuit intendant Liu Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 Li Bin fled to Nanjiang and was taken by Liu Qing, the Jianda intendant.

sentences.zh: 三月，張天倫、魏學盛擾川北，遣總兵田朝貴往剿，不利；

translations.literal: In the third month Zhang Tianlun and Wei Xuesheng harassed northern Sichuan; he sent Commander Tian Chaogui to suppress them without success;
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 Zhang Tianlun and Wei Xuesheng raided northern Sichuan; Tian Chaogui failed against them;

sentences.zh: 親率羅思舉等繼進，大敗賊於巴州，天倫、學盛並就殲。

translations.literal: he himself led Luo Siju and others in a follow-up advance and routed the rebels at Bazhou; Tianlun and Xuesheng were both destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao then led Luo Siju and others forward and crushed them at Bazhou; Tianlun and Xuesheng perished.

sentences.zh: 五月，遣羅聲皋、達斯呼勒岱剿擒白號庹向瑤；

translations.literal: In the fifth month he sent Luo Shenggao and Dasihuledai to suppress and capture the White-band Tuo Xiangyao;
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Luo Shenggao and Dasihuledai captured Tuo Xiangyao of the White band;

sentences.zh: 總兵張績剿青號，擒徐天培；

translations.literal: Commander Zhang Ji suppressed the Green band and captured Xu Tianpei;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ji took Xu Tianpei of the Green band;

sentences.zh: 田朝貴剿藍號，殲楊步青。

translations.literal: Tian Chaogui suppressed the Blue band and destroyed Yang Buqing.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chaogui destroyed Yang Buqing of the Blue band.

sentences.zh: 七月，劉朝選糾青、藍、黃號殘匪竄大寧，勒保遣將擊之，羅思舉擒朝選，達斯呼勒岱殲賴飛隴，詔晉一等男。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Liu Chaoxuan gathered remnant Green, Blue, and Yellow bands in Daning; Le Bao sent officers against them; Luo Siju captured Chaoxuan and Dasihuledai destroyed Lai Feilong; an edict advanced him to first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 Liu Chaoxuan rallied Green, Blue, and Yellow remnants in Daning; Luo Siju seized him and Dasihuledai killed Lai Feilong; Le Bao was raised to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 十月，羅思舉擒張簡，而湯思蛟敗竄亦就獲。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Luo Siju captured Zhang Jian, and the defeated Tang Sijiao was also taken.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 Luo Siju took Zhang Jian and Tang Sijiao was captured in flight.

sentences.zh: 十一月，思舉擒黃號唐明萬。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Siju captured the Yellow-band Tang Mingwan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 Siju seized Tang Mingwan of the Yellow band.

sentences.zh: 時川中著名逆首率就擒殲；

translations.literal: By then the famous rebel chiefs in Sichuan were largely captured or killed;
translations.idiomatic: By then Sichuan's notorious rebel leaders were mostly dead or in chains;

sentences.zh: 餘匪竄老林，不復成股。

translations.literal: the remainder fled into the great forest and no longer formed large bands.
translations.idiomatic: survivors hid in the great forest in scattered bands.

sentences.zh: 在陝、楚者亦多為額勒登保、德楞泰所殲。

translations.literal: Those in Shaanxi and Hubei were also largely destroyed by Eledengbao and Delengtai.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Hubei remnants fell chiefly to Eledengbao and Delengtai.

sentences.zh: 十二月，合疏馳奏蕆功，晉封一等伯爵，仍以「威勤」為號。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they jointly memorialized by rapid dispatch that the task was complete; he was advanced to first-class earl, still with the style Weiqin.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 they jointly reported victory; Le Bao was made a first-class earl, still styled Weiqin.

sentences.zh: 八年，搜捕餘匪，擒白號苟文富、宋國品、張順，青號王青，招降黃號王國賢，偕額勒登保、德楞泰會奏肅清。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he searched out remnant bandits, capturing the White-band Gou Wenfu, Song Guopin, and Zhang Shun, the Green-band Wang Qing, and inducing the Yellow-band Wang Guoxian to surrender; with Eledengbao and Delengtai he jointly memorialized that the province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he mopped up remnants—Gou Wenfu, Song Guopin, Zhang Shun, Wang Qing—and won Wang Guoxian's surrender; with Eledengbao and Delengtai he declared Sichuan clear.

sentences.zh: 未幾，陝西南山餘孽復起，至九年八月始平。

translations.literal: Before long remnant trouble in the southern hills of Shaanxi flared again and was not pacified until the eighth month of the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's southern hills rebelled again and were not quiet until month 8 of year 9.

sentences.zh: 十年，入覲，詔曰：「自嘉慶四年，勒保在川省令鄉民分結寨落，匪始無由焚劫，且助官軍擊賊。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he came to court for audience; an edict said: "From Jiaqing 4, when Le Bao in Sichuan ordered the people to form stockaded settlements, the bandits could no longer raid and burn, and even aided the government armies in striking the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he attended court; the Emperor said Le Bao's stockades from Jiaqing 4 had stopped rebel raids and even helped government troops.

sentences.zh: 其後陝、楚仿行，賊勢乃促。

translations.literal: Afterward Shaanxi and Hubei copied the practice and rebel power was compressed.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Hubei followed, tightening the rebels' grip.

sentences.zh: 今​​三省閭閻安堵，實得力此策為多。

translations.literal: Now the three provinces are tranquil at the hearth; this policy contributed most.
translations.idiomatic: The three provinces are now largely at peace—chiefly thanks to that policy.

sentences.zh: 加太子太保、雙眼花翎，回鎮四川，與民休息。」

translations.literal: He was given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent rank, double-eyed peacock feathers, and sent back to govern Sichuan and let the people rest."
translations.idiomatic: He received Grand Guardian rank, double peacock feathers, and returned to Sichuan to let the people recover.

sentences.zh: 時解散鄉勇，令入伍為兵。

translations.literal: At the time rural braves were disbanded and enrolled as regular soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Militia were then disbanded and enrolled as regulars.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，陝西寧陝鎮新兵倡亂，遣總兵唐文淑往援剿，叛將蒲大芳縛首逆乞降，德楞泰受之。

translations.literal: In autumn of the eleventh year new troops of Ningshan garrison in Shaanxi mutinied; he sent Commander Tang Wenshu to aid in suppression; the mutinous officer Pu Dafang bound the ringleaders and begged to surrender, and Delengtai accepted.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of year 11 Ningshan new troops mutinied; Tang Wenshu was sent; Pu Dafang bound the leaders and surrendered—Delengtai accepted.

sentences.zh: 勒保奏劾：「叛兵罪重於逆匪，率以納降。

translations.literal: Le Bao memorialized in impeachment: "Mutinous soldiers are guiltier than rebels, yet they are repeatedly received by surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao impeached the policy: "Mutineers outrank rebels in guilt yet are repeatedly spared by surrender.

sentences.zh: 不知畏威，安能悔罪？

translations.literal: If they do not fear authority, how can they repent their crimes?
translations.idiomatic: Without fear of authority there is no repentance.

sentences.zh: 他兵從而生心，益驕難制。」

translations.literal: Other troops will take heart from this and grow harder to control."
translations.idiomatic: Other troops will take heart and grow ungovernable."

sentences.zh: 帝韙其言，命赴陝西會治善後事宜。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved his words and ordered him to Shaanxi to handle follow-up affairs jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed and sent him to Shaanxi on pacification duty.

sentences.zh: 尋聞四川綏定新兵亦叛，桂涵捕擒首逆，磔之，餘黨並論如律。

translations.literal: Soon word came that new troops at Suining in Sichuan also rebelled; Gui Han captured the ringleaders, executed them by dismemberment, and the rest were punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Suining's new troops rebelled too; Gui Han seized the leaders, executed them, and punished the rest.

sentences.zh: 十三年，涼山夷匪擾馬邊廳，剿平之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Liangshan Yi bandits troubled Mabian subprefecture and were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Liangshan Yi raiders at Mabian were pacified.

sentences.zh: 十四年，拜武英殿大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory while retaining the governor-generalship.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he became Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory while keeping the governorship.

sentences.zh: 十五年，召來京供職。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was summoned to the capital to serve at court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 坐在四川隱匿名揭帖未奏，降授工部尚書，調刑部。

translations.literal: For concealing an anonymous placard in Sichuan without memorializing, he was demoted to Minister of Works and transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to Minister of Works, then Punishments, for hiding an anonymous placard in Sichuan without reporting it.

sentences.zh: 十六年，出為兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he went out as governor-general of Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he became Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 尋內召，复授武英殿大學士，管理吏部，改兵部，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Soon he was recalled within and again appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory, directing the Ministry of Personnel, then War, and made chief commandant of the imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled, made Grand Secretary again, directed Personnel then War, and became chief imperial bodyguard commandant.

sentences.zh: 十八年，充軍機大臣，兼管理籓院。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he served on the Grand Council and also directed the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he joined the Grand Council and directed the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十九年，以病乞休，食威勤伯全俸。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he asked to retire on grounds of illness and received the full salary of the Weiqin earldom.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he retired ill, keeping the Weiqin earl's full stipend.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，卒，詔贈一等侯，諡文襄。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he died; an edict posthumously granted first-class marquis rank and gave the posthumous title Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 24; the court posthumously made him a first-class marquis with the posthumous name Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 勒保短小精悍，多智數。

translations.literal: Le Bao was short, wiry, and keen-witted.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao was small, wiry, and resourceful.

sentences.zh: 知其父金川之役以剛愎敗，一反所為，寄心膂於諸將帥，優禮寮屬，俾各盡其長，卒成大功。

translations.literal: Knowing his father had failed in the Jinchuan campaign through obstinacy, he did the opposite, trusting his generals and treating his staff generously so each could use his strength, and in the end achieved great success.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing his father's Jinchuan failure came from stubbornness, he trusted his generals, honored his staff, and won the war by letting each man do his best.

sentences.zh: 晚入閣，益斂鋒芒，結同朝之歡，而內分涇、渭。

translations.literal: Entering the Grand Secretariat late, he further restrained his edge, cultivated harmony with colleagues at court, yet inwardly drew lines between factions.
translations.idiomatic: Late in life in the cabinet he softened his manner and courted colleagues, though factions still divided him inwardly.

sentences.zh: 既罷相，帝眷注不衰，命皇四子瑞親王娶其女，以恩禮終。

translations.literal: After leaving the premiership the Emperor's favor did not fade; he had the fourth imperial son, Prince Rui, marry his daughter, and he ended his days in imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: After leaving office he remained favored; Prince Rui married his daughter, and he died in honor.

sentences.zh: 子九，長英惠，科布多參贊大臣，襲三等威勤侯，卒；

translations.literal: He had nine sons; the eldest Yinghui was commissioner at Kobdo, inherited the third-class Weiqin marquisate, and died;
translations.idiomatic: Of nine sons, the eldest Yinghui served at Kobdo, inherited the third-class Weiqin marquisate, and died;

sentences.zh: 孫文厚，嗣爵。

translations.literal: his grandson Wenhou succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: grandson Wenhou succeeded to the title.

sentences.zh: 第四子英綬，工部侍郎；

translations.literal: The fourth son Yingshou was vice minister of works;
translations.idiomatic: The fourth son Yingshou became vice minister of works;

sentences.zh: 孫文俊，江西巡撫。

translations.literal: his grandson Wenjun was governor of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: grandson Wenjun became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保，字珠軒，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Eledengbao, styled Zhuxuan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao, courtesy name Zhuxuan, was a Guwalgiya Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 世為吉林珠戶，隸打牲總管。

translations.literal: His family for generations were Jilin pearl divers under the hunting superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been Jilin pearl fishers under the hunting superintendent.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，以馬甲從征緬甸大小金川，累擢三等侍衛，賜號和隆阿巴圖魯，乾清門行走。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign, as a soldier he followed campaigns in Burma and the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan, was promoted repeatedly to third-class bodyguard, was granted the title Helong'a Batulu, and served in the Qianqing Gate guard.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong he campaigned in Burma and Jinchuan, rose to third-class bodyguard, received the title Helong'a Batulu, and served at the Qianqing Gate.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，剿甘肅石峰堡回匪。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he suppressed Hui bandits at Shifengbao in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 49 he fought Hui rebels at Shifengbao in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，平台灣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he pacified Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 52 he pacified Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 疊遷御前侍衛。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，從福康安徵廓爾喀，攝駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year he followed Fuk'ang'an against Gurkha and acted as resident minister in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In year 56 he followed Fuk'ang'an to Gurkha and acted as Tibet resident minister.

sentences.zh: 攻克擦木賊寨，七戰七勝，抵帕朗古河，班師殿後，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: He stormed the rebel stockade at Camo, won seven battles in seven days, reached the Palung River, covered the withdrawal as rear guard, and was given deputy banner commander rank.
translations.idiomatic: He took Camo in seven victories, reached the Palung River, covered the withdrawal, and received deputy banner commander rank.

sentences.zh: 論台灣、廓爾喀功，兩次圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: For Taiwan and Gurkha merit his portrait was twice placed in the Hall of Purple Glories.
translations.idiomatic: For Taiwan and Gurkha service his portrait entered the Hall of Purple Glories twice.

sentences.zh: 尋授副都統兼護軍統領，擢都統。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed deputy banner commander and acting commandant of the guards, then promoted to banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: He became deputy banner commander and acting guard commandant, then banner commander.

sentences.zh: 六十年，貴州松桃苗石柳鄧、湖南永綏苗石三保相繼叛，陷乾州。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year the Miao Shi Liudeng of Songtao in Guizhou and Shi Sanbao of Yongshun in Hunan rebelled in succession and took Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 60 Shi Liudeng of Songtao, Guizhou, and Shi Sanbao of Yongshun, Hunan, rebelled and seized Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 福康安視師，請額勒登保偕護軍統領德楞泰率巴圖魯侍衛赴軍。

translations.literal: Fuk'ang'an took command and asked that Eledengbao go with Guard Commandant Delengtai leading Baturu bodyguards to the army.
translations.idiomatic: Fuk'ang'an asked Eledengbao and Delengtai to bring Baturu guards to the front.

sentences.zh: 至則松桃圍已解，石柳鄧逸入石三保黃瓜寨中。

translations.literal: When they arrived the Songtao siege was already lifted; Shi Liudeng had escaped into Shi Sanbao's Huangguazhai.
translations.idiomatic: Songtao was already relieved; Liudeng had fled into Sanbao's Huangguazhai.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保由松桃進攻，解永綏圍，克黃瓜寨。

translations.literal: Eledengbao advanced from Songtao, relieved the Yongshun siege, and took Huangguazhai.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao advanced from Songtao, lifted Yongshun, and took Huangguazhai.

sentences.zh: 攻賊首吳半生於蘇麻寨，克西梁；

translations.literal: He attacked the rebel chief Wu Bansheng at Sumazhai and took Xiliang;
translations.idiomatic: He struck Wu Bansheng at Sumazhai and took Xiliang;

sentences.zh: 半生遁高多寨，擒之：授內大臣。

translations.literal: Bansheng fled to Gaoduo stockade; he was captured: Eledengbao was made inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: Bansheng fled to Gaoduo and was captured; Eledengbao became an inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 又獲乾州賊目吳八月，餘黨據平隴，進抵長吉山，敗之。

translations.literal: He also captured the Qianzhou rebel leader Wu Babu; the remainder held Pinglong, and advancing to Changji Mountain he defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He took Wu Babu of Qianzhou; remnants held Pinglong and were beaten at Changji Mountain.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，福康安卒，和琳代。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing Fuk'ang'an died and Helin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 Fuk'ang'an died and Helin succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 時石三保就擒，石柳鄧在平隴，乃進兵复乾州，賜花翎，署領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: By then Shi Sanbao had been captured and Shi Liudeng was at Pinglong; he advanced to recover Qianzhou, was granted peacock feathers, and acted as chief commandant of the imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Sanbao was taken and Liudeng held Pinglong; he recovered Qianzhou, received peacock feathers, and acted as chief bodyguard commandant.

sentences.zh: 秋，和琳卒於軍，統兵者惟額勒登保、德楞泰及湖南巡撫姜晟三人。

translations.literal: In autumn Helin died in the army; those commanding troops were only Eledengbao, Delengtai, and Hunan Governor Jiang Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Helin died in camp; only Eledengbao, Delengtai, and Jiang Sheng remained in command.

sentences.zh: 詔將軍明亮、提督鄂輝往會剿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General Mingliang and Provincial Commander-in-Chief E'hui to join the suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang and E'hui were ordered to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 十月，克平隴，石柳鄧遁踞養牛塘山梁，分兵克之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Pinglong was taken; Shi Liudeng fled to Yangniutang ridge and was driven from successive positions.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 Pinglong fell; Liudeng held Yangniutang and was driven from position after position.

sentences.zh: 十二月，斬石柳鄧，苗縛吳八月子廷義以獻。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Shi Liudeng was beheaded; the Miao bound Wu Babu's son Tingyi and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 Liudeng was beheaded; Miao captors sent Wu Babu's son Tingyi.

sentences.zh: 軍事告竣，詔嘉其功最，錫封威勇侯，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: With military affairs concluded, an edict praised his merit as greatest, enfeoffed him as Marquis Weiyong, and granted double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: The war ended; the court praised him above all, made him Marquis Weiyong, and gave double peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 二年，移師剿湖北教匪。

translations.literal: In the second year he shifted troops to suppress sect rebels in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he turned to the Hubei sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 時林之華、覃加耀踞長陽黃柏山，地險糧足，總督福寧攻之久不下。

translations.literal: Lin Zhihua and Tan Jiayao held Huangbai Mountain in Changyang, a strong position with ample grain; Governor-General Funing had attacked long without success.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Zhihua and Tan Jiayao held well-supplied Huangbai Mountain in Changyang; Funing had besieged them in vain.

sentences.zh: 三月，額勒登保至，克四方台。

translations.literal: In the third month Eledengbao arrived and took Sifangtai.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 Eledengbao arrived and took Sifangtai.

sentences.zh: 賊遁鶴峰芭葉山，其險隘曰大拏口，六月克之。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Baye Mountain at Hefeng; its dangerous pass called Danakou was taken in the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: They fled to Hefeng's Baye Mountain; its Danakou pass fell in month 6.

sentences.zh: 賊竄宣恩、建始，分兵三路進，十月，斃之華於大茅田，而加耀遁施南山中，尋竄長樂硃裡寨，三面懸崖，惟東南一徑。

translations.literal: The rebels slipped into Xuan'en and Jianshi; he advanced on three routes; in the tenth month he killed Zhihua at Damaotian, while Jiayao fled into Shinan Mountain and soon lurked at Changle Zhuli stockade, cliff-bound on three sides with only one southeast path.
translations.idiomatic: They slipped into Xuan'en and Jianshi; in month 10 he killed Zhihua at Damaotian while Jiayao hid on Shinan Mountain, then Changle Zhuli—cliffs on three sides, one path southeast.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遣死士縋登，掘地窖火藥轟之，賊爭走，墜崖，坑谷皆滿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he sent daredevils to rope down, dug an underground powder magazine and blasted it; the rebels rushed out, fell from the cliffs, and the ravines were filled.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 daredevils roped in; a powder mine blew the stockade; rebels rushed out, fell from cliffs, and filled the ravines.

sentences.zh: 惟加耀偕賊二百遁，踞歸州終報寨。

translations.literal: Only Jiayao escaped with two hundred bandits and held Zhongbao stockade in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Only Jiayao escaped with two hundred men and held Zhongbao in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 詔斥額勒登保縱賊，降三等伯爵。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Eledengbao for letting bandits escape and reduced him to third-class earl.
translations.idiomatic: The court rebuked him for letting Jiayao escape and cut him to third-class earl.

sentences.zh: 三年春，加耀始就擒，仍以蕆事緩，奪爵職、花翎，予副都統銜，命赴陝西協剿襄匪高均德、姚之富、齊王氏等。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year Jiayao was finally captured, but because completion was still delayed his title and peacock feathers were stripped and he was given deputy banner commander rank and ordered to Shaanxi to assist in suppressing the Xiang bandits Gao Junde, Yao Zhifu, and Qi Wangshi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 3 Jiayao was taken, but delay cost him his title and feathers; he became deputy banner commander and went to Shaanxi against Gao Junde, Yao Zhifu, and Qi Wangshi.

sentences.zh: 會李全自盩厔至藍田，欲與諸賊合，擊走之。

translations.literal: When Li Quan came from Zhouzhi to Lantian intending to join the other bandits, Eledengbao drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan moved from Zhouzhi toward Lantian to join the rebels; Eledengbao drove him off.

sentences.zh: 姚之富、齊王氏失援，遂為明亮、德楞泰所殲。

translations.literal: Yao Zhifu and Qi Wangshi, losing support, were then destroyed by Mingliang and Delengtai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhifu and Qi Wangshi, cut off, were destroyed by Mingliang and Delengtai.

sentences.zh: 進剿均德於兩岔河，賊分竄商州、鎮安。

translations.literal: Pressing Junde at Liangcha River, the bandits split toward Shangzhou and Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed Junde at Liangcha River; the rebels split toward Shangzhou and Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 四月，赴荊州會剿張漢潮，敗之竹山，躡追，由陝西入四川。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he went to Jingzhou to join in suppressing Zhang Hanchao, defeated him at Zhushan, pursued, and followed from Shaanxi into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 he joined the hunt for Zhang Hanchao, beat him at Zhushan, and pursued into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 九月，擊漢潮於廣元，擒其子正漋。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he struck Hanchao at Guangyuan and captured his son Zhengyong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 he struck Hanchao at Guangyuan and took his son Zhengyong.

sentences.zh: 與德楞泰等合剿川匪羅其清。

translations.literal: With Delengtai and others he jointly suppressed the Sichuan bandit Luo Qiqing.
translations.idiomatic: With Delengtai he jointly suppressed Luo Qiqing in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 其清踞營山之箕山，已為德楞泰所破，竄大鵬寨。

translations.literal: Qiqing held Jishan in Yingshan but had already been broken by Delengtai and fled to Dapeng stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Qiqing held Jishan in Yingshan but Delengtai had already broken him; he fled to Dapeng stockade.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保與德楞泰、惠齡、恆瑞四路進攻，十月合圍。

translations.literal: Eledengbao with Delengtai, Hui Ling, and Hengrui advanced on four routes and encircled them in the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 Eledengbao, Delengtai, Hui Ling, and Hengrui closed in from four sides.

sentences.zh: 其清突走青觀山，樹柵距險。

translations.literal: Qiqing broke out to Qingguan Mountain and built palisades in a strong position.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqing broke out to Qingguan Mountain and fortified the heights.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保鑑於黃柏山、芭葉山頓兵之失，議主急攻，親逼柵前，席地坐，令楊遇春督兵囊土立營，且戰且築，諸軍繼之，攻擊七晝夜。

translations.literal: Eledengbao, recalling the stalemates at Huangbai and Baye mountains, urged rapid assault; he sat on the ground before the palisade, had Yang Yuchun supervise troops bagging earth to raise camps, fighting and building together, with other armies following—seven days and nights of attack.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Huangbai and Baye, Eledengbao pressed a rush assault; he sat before the palisade while Yang Yuchun raised earthworks under fire for seven days and nights.

sentences.zh: 賊不支，竄渡​​巴河，踞遂風寨廢堡。

translations.literal: The bandits could not hold, fled across the Ba River, and held the ruined fort of Suifeng stockade.
translations.idiomatic: They broke, crossed the Ba River, and held ruined Suifeng stockade.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰同至，圍之數重，勢垂克，薄暮，忽傳令撤圍。

translations.literal: Delengtai arrived together, invested them in many rings, and victory was near; at dusk a sudden order came to withdraw the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai joined the siege; victory was near when at dusk came orders to lift the investment.

sentences.zh: 賊傾巢夜潰，遲至黎明始馳追，賊四路逃竄，至方山坪已散盡，獲其清於石穴，逸匪數日內並為民兵擒獻。

translations.literal: The bandits fled by night with their whole force; pursuit began only at dawn; they scattered on four routes, and by Fangshanping the host was gone; Qiqing was taken in a stone cave, and fugitives within days were all seized and presented by militia.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits evacuated by night; pursuit lagged until dawn; they scattered; Qiqing was taken in a cave and the rest rounded up by militia within days.

sentences.zh: 是役，賊趨絕地，無外援，開網縱之，飢疲就縛，士卒不損，竟全功焉，复花翎。

translations.literal: In this campaign the bandits had been driven to a dead end without outside aid; the net was opened and they were taken starving and weary with little loss to the troops—the merit was complete, and peacock feathers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Trapped without relief, they were starved into capture with few troop losses; his feathers were restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月，追徐天德、冷天祿於合州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he pursued Xu Tiande and Leng Tianlu at Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 he pursued Xu Tiande and Leng Tianlu at Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 四年春，詔以勒保為經略大臣，額勒登保與明亮同授副都統為參贊。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year an edict made Le Bao supreme commander, with Eledengbao and Mingliang both appointed deputy banner commanders as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 4 Le Bao became supreme commander; Eledengbao and Mingliang were made deputy banner commanders as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 三月，追冷天祿於大竹，聞蕭佔國、張長庚由閬州竄營山，回軍迎擊。

translations.literal: In the third month he pursued Leng Tianlu at Dazhu; hearing Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng had slipped from Langzhou into Yingshan, he turned back to intercept.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 he pursued Leng Tianlu at Dazhu; hearing Xiao Zhanguo and Zhang Changgeng were raiding from Langzhou into Yingshan, he turned back.

sentences.zh: 賊踞黃土坪，臨江負山，令總兵硃射鬥繞出雞猴寨，截其西；

translations.literal: The bandits held Huangtuping facing the river with mountains behind; he ordered Commander Zhu Shedou to circle by Jihou stockade and block the west;
translations.idiomatic: They held Huangtuping above the river; Zhu Shedou was sent around Jihou stockade to block the west;

sentences.zh: 自率楊遇春由東襲攻城隍廟，賊西走，為射鬥所扼，夾擊，殲其半，越山竄走尚數千。

translations.literal: he himself led Yang Yuchun to strike from the east at the city-god temple; the bandits fled west, were checked by Shedou, caught between, and half were destroyed; several thousand still escaped over the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao led Yang Yuchun from the east; the rebels were caught between him and Shedou, half destroyed, though thousands escaped over the hills.

sentences.zh: 乘夜圍擊於譚家山，隕崖死及生擒幾盡，斬佔國、長庚。

translations.literal: He surrounded and struck them by night at Tanjia Mountain; many fell from cliffs or were captured alive, nearly all gone; Zhanguo and Changgeng were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: A night battle at Tanjia Mountain sent many over the cliffs; Zhanguo and Changgeng were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 有冒難民逃出者，投冷天祿，述兵威，天祿曰：「我曾於安樂坪破經略兵數万，何懼此乎？」

translations.literal: Some who escaped disguised as refugees joined Leng Tianlu and described the army's power; Tianlu said, "I once at Anleping broke the supreme commander's tens of thousands—why fear this?"
translations.idiomatic: Refugee impostors reached Leng Tianlu and praised the army; Tianlu said, "At Anleping I broke the supreme commander's host—why fear them?"

sentences.zh: 時踞岳池，距大軍不遠，天祿遣大隊先行，自率悍黨八百殿後。

translations.literal: At the time he held Yuechi, not far from the main army; Tianlu sent the main body ahead and himself led eight hundred fierce followers in the rear.
translations.idiomatic: He held Yuechi near the main force; Tianlu sent the bulk ahead with eight hundred veterans in the rear.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保冒雨由間道進至廣安，令穆克登布據石頭堰以待，楊遇春潛出賊後；

translations.literal: Eledengbao advanced through a bypath in the rain to Guang'an, ordered Mukedengbu to hold Shitouyan in wait, and Yang Yuchun slipped behind the bandits;
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao marched through rain by a bypath to Guang'an, posted Mukedengbu at Shitouyan, and sent Yang Yuchun behind the rebels;

sentences.zh: 自將索倫勁騎沖之，賊死鬥，天祿斃於箭。

translations.literal: he himself led fierce Solon cavalry in a charge; the bandits fought to the death and Tianlu was killed by arrows.
translations.idiomatic: He charged with Solon cavalry; Tianlu fell to arrows in the melee.

sentences.zh: 次日，迫其大隊於石筍河，斬溺過半，先渡者追殲之。

translations.literal: The next day he pressed their main body at Shixun River; more than half were killed or drowned, and those who crossed first were pursued and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Next day at Shixun River more than half were killed or drowned; survivors who crossed were hunted down.

sentences.zh: 旬日間連殄三劇賊，疊詔嘉賚，先封二等男爵，晉一等。

translations.literal: Within ten days three fierce bandit chiefs were destroyed in succession; repeated edicts praised and rewarded him; he was first made second-class baron, then advanced to first class.
translations.idiomatic: In ten days three major chiefs fell; edicts piled praise on him; he rose from second-class to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 四月，追剿白號張子聰於雲陽，子聰糾合黃號樊人傑、線號蕭焜、卜三聘等，疊敗之寒水壩，賊稍散。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he pursued the White-band Zhang Zicong at Yunyang; Zicong gathered the Yellow-band Fan Renjie, Red-band Xiao Kun, Bu Sanpin, and others; he defeated them repeatedly at Hanshuiba and the bandits scattered somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 he pursued Zhang Zicong at Yunyang; Zicong rallied Fan Renjie, Xiao Kun, Bu Sanpin, and others; repeated defeats at Hanshuiba scattered them.

sentences.zh: 五月，子聰復合冉天元窺陝境，扼御之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Zicong again joined Ran Tianyuan to probe the Shaanxi border and was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Zicong joined Ran Tianyuan to probe Shaanxi and was blocked.

sentences.zh: 子聰竄通江，追敗之於苟家坪，又敗天元於木老壩。

translations.literal: Zicong fled to Tongjiang; he was defeated in pursuit at Goujiaping and Tianyuan was beaten at Mulaoba.
translations.idiomatic: Zicong fled to Tongjiang, was beaten at Goujiaping, and Tianyuan at Mulaoba.

sentences.zh: 七月，天元竄鎮龍關，欲與王登廷合，登廷屯馬鞍寨，擊走之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Tianyuan lurked at Zhenlong Pass intending to join Wang Dengting; Dengting held Ma'an stockade and was driven off.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 Tianyuan aimed for Zhenlong Pass to join Wang Dengting; Dengting at Ma'an stockade was driven off.

sentences.zh: 窮追至大竹、東鄉，援賊麕至，分兵進擊，擒斬甚眾，仍躡登廷。

translations.literal: Pressed to Dazhu and Dongxiang, relief bandits gathered; he divided troops to strike, killed and captured many, and still pursued Dengting.
translations.idiomatic: Pressed toward Dazhu and Dongxiang, he divided forces, killed many, and kept after Dengting.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保戰績為諸軍最，湖北道員胡齊崙治餉餽送諸將，事發，獨無所受，詔嘉其「忠勇公清，為東三省人傑」。

translations.literal: Eledengbao's battle record was foremost among the armies; when Hubei circuit intendant Hu Qilun was prosecuted for supplying the generals, Eledengbao alone had taken nothing; an edict praised his "loyal bravery, public integrity, and clarity—a man of talent from the eastern provinces."
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao led the armies in victories; when commissary Hu Qilun was prosecuted for supply abuses, Eledengbao alone had taken nothing—the court praised his loyal, incorruptible service.

sentences.zh: 八月，勒保以罪逮，命代為經略，授領侍衛內大臣，補都統。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Le Bao was arrested for crime; Eledengbao was ordered to replace him as supreme commander, made chief commandant of the imperial bodyguard, and restored to banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 Le Bao was arrested; Eledengbao replaced him as supreme commander, became chief bodyguard commandant, and regained banner commander rank.

sentences.zh: 疏陳軍事曰：「臣前數年止領一路偏師，今任經略，當籌全局。

translations.literal: In a memorial on military affairs he said: "Your servant formerly led only one wing; now as supreme commander I must plan the whole.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "I once led a wing; as supreme commander I must see the whole field.

sentences.zh: 教匪本屬編氓，宜招撫以散其眾，然必能剿而後可撫，必能堵而後可剿。

translations.literal: Sect rebels are originally commoners and should be won by inducement to scatter their masses—but one can induce only after one can suppress, and suppress only after one can block.
translations.idiomatic: These rebels are peasants; inducement scatters them—but suppression must come first, and blocking before suppression.

sentences.zh: 從前湖北教匪多，脅從少；

translations.literal: Formerly in Hubei the rebels were many and the coerced few;
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei there were many rebels and few coerced followers;

sentences.zh: 四川教匪少，脅從多。

translations.literal: in Sichuan the rebels were few and the coerced many.
translations.idiomatic: in Sichuan few rebels but many coerced followers.

sentences.zh: 今楚賊盡逼入川，其與川東巫山、大寧接壤者，有界嶺可扼，是湖北重在堵而不在剿。

translations.literal: Now Hubei bandits are all forced into Sichuan; where they border eastern Sichuan at Wushan and Daning there are boundary ridges to hold—so for Hubei blocking matters more than chasing.
translations.idiomatic: Now Hubei rebels are squeezed into Sichuan; along the Wushan-Daning border ridges can hold them—Hubei needs blocking more than chasing.

sentences.zh: 川、陝交界，自廣元至太平，千餘裡隨處可通，陝攻急則入川，川攻急則入陝，是漢江南北剿堵並重。

translations.literal: The Sichuan-Shaanxi border from Guangyuan to Taiping has over a thousand li of passes everywhere; if Shaanxi presses hard they enter Sichuan, if Sichuan presses hard they enter Shaanxi—north and south of the Han both chasing and blocking matter.
translations.idiomatic: From Guangyuan to Taiping the Sichuan-Shaanxi line has a thousand li of crossings—pressure on either side shifts the rebels; both chase and block matter along the Han.

sentences.zh: 川東、川北有嘉陵江以限其西南，餘皆崇山峻嶺，居民近皆扼險築寨，團練守禦；

translations.literal: Eastern and northern Sichuan have the Jialing to limit the southwest; elsewhere are lofty mountains where people now hold passes and build stockades with militia defense;
translations.idiomatic: East and north Sichuan are bounded southwest by the Jialing; elsewhere people hold passes in stockades with militia;

sentences.zh: 而川北形勢更便於川東，若能驅各路之賊偪川北，必可聚而殲旃：是四川重在剿而不在堵。

translations.literal: northern Sichuan's terrain is even more favorable than eastern; if every route's bandits can be driven into northern Sichuan they can be gathered and destroyed—so Sichuan stresses chasing over blocking.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Sichuan is easier to defend than the east; drive all bands north and they can be annihilated—Sichuan must chase more than block.

sentences.zh: 但使所至堡寨羅布，兵隨其後，遇賊迎截夾擊，以堵為剿，事半功倍，此則三省所同。

translations.literal: But if stockades lie thick wherever they go and troops follow, meeting bandits with interception and pincers—using block as chase—the effort halves; this the three provinces share.
translations.idiomatic: With stockades everywhere and troops behind, intercept and pincer—block as chase—and the three provinces share the same method.

sentences.zh: 臣已行知陝、楚，曉諭修築，並定賞格，以期兵民同心蹙賊。

translations.literal: Your servant has already informed Shaanxi and Hubei, instructed them to build and repair, and set rewards so soldiers and people together compress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: I have urged Shaanxi and Hubei to build stockades and set rewards so troops and people squeeze the rebels together.

sentences.zh: 至從征官兵，日行百十里，旬月尚可耐勞，若閱四五年之久，騾馬尚且踣斃，何況於人？

translations.literal: As for campaign troops marching a hundred or more li a day, they can endure a month or so; over four or five years even pack animals collapse—how much more men?
translations.idiomatic: Campaign troops can march a hundred li a day for a month; over four or five years even mules die—what of men?

sentences.zh: 續調新募者，不習勞苦，更不如舊兵。

translations.literal: Newly recruited replacements are unused to hardship and are worse than the old soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Fresh recruits suffer worse than veterans.

sentences.zh: 臣一軍尚能得力者，以兵士所到之處，亦臣所到之處；

translations.literal: Your servant's army still performs because wherever the soldiers go, your servant also goes;
translations.idiomatic: My army works because I go where my men go;

sentences.zh: 兵士不得食息，臣亦不得食息。

translations.literal: when the soldiers cannot eat or rest, your servant also cannot eat or rest.
translations.idiomatic: when they cannot rest, neither can I.

sentences.zh: 自將弁以及士卒，無不一心一力，而各路不能盡然。

translations.literal: From officers to rank and file all are of one mind and one effort, but the various routes are not all so.
translations.idiomatic: My men are united; other routes are not.

sentences.zh: 近日不得已，將臣兵與各提鎮互相更調，以期人人精銳。」

translations.literal: Recently, having no choice, your servant has exchanged troops with each provincial commander so that every man may be sharp."
translations.idiomatic: I have lately swapped troops with other commanders to sharpen every unit."

sentences.zh: 又言：「軍中出力人員，應隨時鼓勵，令各路領兵大員，自行保奏，以免諮送遲延。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Those who exert themselves in the army should be encouraged in season; let each route's commander recommend his own men, lest central referral cause delay."
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that front-line heroes be rewarded promptly by their own commanders without central delay."

sentences.zh: 帝並韙之。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved both points.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved both proposals.

sentences.zh: 時徐天德敗於湖北，折回川東，漸衰弱；

translations.literal: At the time Xu Tiande had been defeated in Hubei and doubled back to eastern Sichuan, gradually weakening;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Tiande, beaten in Hubei, had doubled back east and was fading;

sentences.zh: 而王登廷與冉天元、苟文明合阮正漋竄廣元，賊勢重在川北。

translations.literal: but Wang Dengting joined Ran Tianyuan and Gou Wenming with Ruan Zhengyong in raiding Guangyuan, and rebel strength centered on northern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dengting, Tianyuan, Gou Wenming, and Ruan Zhengyong massed in northern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 九月，率楊遇春殲正漋於雲霧山。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he led Yang Yuchun and destroyed Zhengyong at Yunwu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 Yang Yuchun destroyed Zhengyong at Yunwu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十一月，登廷、天德、天元及樊人傑會合抗拒，疊戰於巴州何家院、東君壩，擒賊目賈正舉、王國安，追至蒼溪貓兒埡。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Dengting, Tiande, Tianyuan, and Fan Renjie united to resist; he fought repeatedly at Hejiayuan in Bazhou and Dongjunba, captured the bandit leaders Jia Zhengju and Wang Guo'an, and pursued to Mao'erya in Cangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 the chiefs united; battles at Hejiayuan and Dongjunba took Jia Zhengju and Wang Guo'an; pursuit reached Mao'erya.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保以天元善戰，令楊遇春、穆克登布合左右翼力擊。

translations.literal: Eledengbao, because Tianyuan was a skilled fighter, ordered Yang Yuchun and Mukedengbu to strike with both wings.
translations.idiomatic: Because Tianyuan fought well, Eledengbao ordered Yang Yuchun and Mukedengbu to hit both flanks.

sentences.zh: 穆克登布輕進，為天元所乘，傷亡甚眾；

translations.literal: Mukedengbu advanced rashly, was caught by Tianyuan, and casualties were heavy;
translations.idiomatic: Mukedengbu advanced rashly and suffered heavy loss;

sentences.zh: 賊萃攻經略中營，血戰竟夜，賊始退，次日，登廷在南江為鄉團所擒。
