translations.literal: the bandits massed against the supreme commander's central camp and fought through the night before retreating; the next day Dengting was captured at Nanjiang by local militia.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed Eledengbao's headquarters all night; next day militia took Dengting at Nanjiang.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保以實聞，詔嘉其不諱敗，不攘功，不鬼大臣。

translations.literal: Eledengbao reported truthfully; an edict praised him for not concealing defeat, not seizing credit, and not shifting blame onto senior colleagues.
translations.idiomatic: He reported honestly; the court praised him for not hiding defeat, seizing credit, or blaming superiors.

sentences.zh: 天元竄開縣，額勒登保病留太平，遣楊遇春、穆克登布追之。

translations.literal: Tianyuan fled to Kaixian; Eledengbao fell ill and remained at Taiping, sending Yang Yuchun and Mukedengbu in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyuan fled to Kaixian; ill, Eledengbao stayed at Taiping and sent Yang Yuchun and Mukedengbu after him.

sentences.zh: 將與德楞泰夾擊，而楊開甲、辛聰、王廷詔、高天升、馬學禮諸賊以川北守禦嚴，無所掠，乘間由老林竄陝西城固、南鄭，提督王文雄不能禦，前路賊且入甘肅。

translations.literal: He was about to join Delengtai in a pincer when Yang Kaijia, Xin Cong, Wang Tingzhao, Gao Tiansheng, Ma Xueli, and others, finding northern Sichuan defenses strict and nothing to plunder, slipped through the great forest into Chenggu and Nanzheng in Shaanxi; Provincial Commander Wang Wenxiong could not stop them and the front feared they would enter Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: A pincer with Delengtai was planned, but Kaijia, Xin Cong, Tingzhao, Tiansheng, and Xueli slipped through the great forest into Shaanxi; Wang Wenxiong failed to stop them and they threatened Gansu.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保疏請以川事付魁倫、德楞泰，自力疾赴陝，而德楞泰先已西行赴援，不及回軍。

translations.literal: Eledengbao memorialized asking that Sichuan affairs be left to Kuilun and Delengtai while he went to Shaanxi despite illness; Delengtai had already gone west to aid and could not return.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to leave Sichuan to Kuilun and Delengtai and go to Shaanxi ill; Delengtai was already westward.

sentences.zh: 五年春，天元糾脅日眾，乘魁倫初受事，遂奪渡嘉陵江，硃射鬥戰死。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifth year Tianyuan's following grew daily; taking advantage of Kuilun's new command, they seized a Jialing crossing and Zhu Shedou died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 5 Tianyuan's host grew; Kuilun, newly in command, lost the Jialing crossing and Zhu Shedou fell.

sentences.zh: 未幾，潼河复失守，川中震動。

translations.literal: Before long the Tong River was lost again and Sichuan was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Tong River fell again and Sichuan was alarmed.

sentences.zh: 詔逮魁倫，起勒保與德楞泰同辦川賊，責額勒登保與那彥成專剿陝賊。

translations.literal: An edict arrested Kuilun, recalled Le Bao and Delengtai to handle Sichuan bandits, and charged Eledengbao with Nayancheng to specialize in Shaanxi bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilun was arrested; Le Bao and Delengtai took Sichuan; Eledengbao and Nayancheng took Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 時那彥成破南山餘賊於隴山、伏羌，德楞泰追王廷詔、楊開甲於成縣。

translations.literal: At the time Nayancheng had broken southern-hill remnant bandits at Longshan and Fuxiang, and Delengtai pursued Wang Tingzhao and Yang Kaijia at Chengxian.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng had beaten southern-hill remnants; Delengtai pursued Tingzhao and Kaijia at Chengxian.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保亦至，乃令德楞泰回川西，自與那彥成分三路，遏賊入川及北竄之路。

translations.literal: Eledengbao also arrived and ordered Delengtai back to western Sichuan while he with Nayancheng divided into three routes to block entry into Sichuan and flight north.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao sent Delengtai back west and with Nayancheng blocked paths into Sichuan and north.

sentences.zh: 楊遇春、穆克登布破張天倫於岷州，慶成等破張世龍於洮河。

translations.literal: Yang Yuchun and Mukedengbu broke Zhang Tianlun at Minzhou; Qingcheng and others broke Zhang Shilong on the Tao River.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuchun beat Zhang Tianlun at Minzhou; Qingcheng beat Zhang Shilong on the Tao.

sentences.zh: 廷詔、開甲合犯大營，擊走之，分兵追賊。

translations.literal: Tingzhao and Kaijia together attacked the main camp and were driven off; troops were divided to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhao and Kaijia attacked headquarters and were repulsed; pursuit was divided.

sentences.zh: 大軍移剿高天升、馬學禮，迭敗之，賊逾渭北竄，尋要之於鞏昌，又要廷詔、開甲於岷州。

translations.literal: The main force shifted to suppress Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli, defeated them repeatedly, the bandits crossed north of the Wei and fled, were intercepted at Gongchang, and Tingzhao and Kaijia were caught again at Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The main army beat Tiansheng and Xueli, drove them north of the Wei, intercepted at Gongchang, and caught Tingzhao and Kaijia at Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 諸賊並逼回渭南，而張世龍等走秦州，將趨北棧。

translations.literal: All bandits were forced back to Weinan while Zhang Shilong and others went to Qinzhou intending the northern plank road.
translations.idiomatic: All bands were pushed to Weinan while Shilong aimed for the northern plank road through Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 留那彥成追高、馬二賊，自率楊遇春、岱森保回陝，令王文雄及總兵索費英阿等分扼南北棧。

translations.literal: Leaving Nayancheng to pursue Gao and Ma, he himself led Yang Yuchun and Daisenbao back to Shaanxi and ordered Wang Wenxiong and Commander Suofei Ying'a to hold the southern and northern plank roads.
translations.idiomatic: He left Nayancheng after Gao and Ma and with Yang Yuchun and Daisenbao held the plank roads through Wang Wenxiong and Suofei Ying'a.

sentences.zh: 張漢潮已為明亮所殲，餘黨留陝者糾合复眾。

translations.literal: Zhang Hanchao had already been destroyed by Mingliang; remnant bandits in Shaanxi gathered and swelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Hanchao was gone; Shaanxi remnants regrouped.

sentences.zh: 張世龍、張天倫為大兵所驅，竄滇安，皆注漢北山中，東向商、雒，賊复蔓延。

translations.literal: Zhang Shilong and Zhang Tianlun, driven by the main armies, fled to Dian'an; all poured into the Hanbei mountains and spread east toward Shang and Luo—the bandits spread again.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong and Tianlun fled to Dian'an and into the Hanbei hills toward Shang and Luo—the rebellion spread again.

sentences.zh: 嚴詔詰責，召那彥成回京。

translations.literal: A stern edict rebuked and Nayancheng was recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The court rebuked them sharply and recalled Nayancheng.

sentences.zh: 閏四月，額勒登保率楊遇春連敗賊於商、雒、兩岔河，令遇春扼龍駒寨，使不得犯河南。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month Eledengbao with Yang Yuchun repeatedly defeated bandits at Shang, Luo, and Liangcha River and posted Yuchun at Longju stockade to keep them from entering Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 4 he beat rebels at Shang, Luo, and Liangcha River and posted Yang Yuchun at Longju to bar Henan.

sentences.zh: 賊乃回竄，留後隊綴官軍，連破之洵陽大、小、中溪，設伏溪口，擒斬三千餘，斃藍號劉允恭、劉開玉，於是漢潮餘黨略盡，晉封三等子。

translations.literal: The bandits then doubled back, leaving a rear guard to delay the army; he repeatedly defeated them at the great, middle, and small streams of Xunyang, ambushed at the stream mouth, killed and captured more than three thousand, and killed the Blue-band Liu Yungong and Liu Kaiyu; thus Hanchao's remnant following was largely gone and he was advanced to third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: They doubled back; he ambushed them at Xunyang's streams, killed three thousand, took Liu Yungong and Liu Kaiyu, and was made third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 楊開甲、辛聰、張世龍、張天倫、伍金柱、戴仕傑等皆西竄。

translations.literal: Yang Kaijia, Xin Cong, Zhang Shilong, Zhang Tianlun, Wu Jinzhu, Dai Shijie, and others all fled west.
translations.idiomatic: Kaijia, Xin Cong, Shilong, Tianlun, Wu Jinzhu, Dai Shijie, and others fled west.

sentences.zh: 五月，令楊遇春等追擊金柱等於漢陰手扳崖，陣斃賊目龐洪勝等。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he ordered Yang Yuchun and others to pursue Jinzhu and others at Shoubanya in Hanyin and killed the bandit chief Pang Hongsheng and others in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Yang Yuchun killed Pang Hongsheng at Shoubanya in Hanyin.

sentences.zh: 進攻楊開甲等於洋縣茅坪，賊踞山巔，誘之出戰，伏兵繞賊後夾擊，陣斬開甲。

translations.literal: Advancing against Yang Kaijia and others at Maoping in Yangxian, the bandits held the mountain crest; he lured them out and with ambush troops circling behind killed Kaijia in battle.
translations.idiomatic: At Yangxian's Maoping he lured Kaijia out and killed him with a rear ambush.

sentences.zh: 六月，賊竄甘肅徽縣、兩當，藍號陳杰偷越棧道，擒之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month bandits fled to Huixian and Liangdang in Gansu; the Blue-band Chen Jie secretly crossed the plank road and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 rebels entered Huixian and Liangdang; Chen Jie of the Blue band crossed the plank road and was taken.

sentences.zh: 八月，遇春斬伍金柱於成縣，斃宋麻子於兩當，賊復回竄陝境。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Yuchun beheaded Wu Jinzhu at Chengxian and killed Song Mazi at Liangdang; the bandits again fled back into Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 Yuchun killed Wu Jinzhu at Chengxian and Song Mazi at Liangdang; rebels re-entered Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 疏陳軍事，略謂：「賊踪飄忽，時分時合，隨殺隨增，東西回竄，官軍受其牽綴，稍不慎即墮術中，堵剿均無速效，自請治罪。」

translations.literal: In a memorial on military affairs he said in summary: "Bandit tracks are elusive, now splitting now joining, killed today and increased tomorrow, darting east and west; government troops are dragged along, and one slight lapse falls into their trick—neither blocking nor chasing has quick effect; your servant asks to be punished."
translations.idiomatic: He confessed that rebels split and merged unpredictably, that troops were always one step behind, and asked punishment.

sentences.zh: 又言：「地廣兵單，請將防兵悉為剿兵，防堵責鄉勇，促築陝、楚寨堡以絕擄掠。」

translations.literal: He also said: "The territory is wide and troops few; please make all garrison troops into campaign troops, leave blocking to militia, and hasten stockades in Shaanxi and Hubei to cut off plunder."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to turn garrisons into strikers, leave blocking to militia, and build stockades in Shaanxi and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 溫詔慰勞，以剿捕責諸將，防堵責疆吏，分專其任。

translations.literal: A warm edict comforted him; pursuit was charged to the generals and blocking to the frontier officials, each with a separate duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor comforted him, leaving pursuit to generals and blocking to local officials.

sentences.zh: 會賊逼武關，截擊走之。

translations.literal: When bandits pressed Wuguan he intercepted and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels threatened Wuguan he turned them back.

sentences.zh: 六年春，奏設寧陝鎮為南山屏障，如議行。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixth year he memorialized to establish Ningshan garrison as a barrier for the southern hills, and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 6 he won approval to establish Ningshan garrison as a southern-hill barrier.

sentences.zh: 二月，楊遇春擒王廷詔於川、陝交界鞍子溝，擒高天德、馬學禮於寧羌龍洞溪，三賊皆最悍。

translations.literal: In the second month Yang Yuchun captured Wang Tingzhao at Anzigo on the Sichuan-Shaanxi border, and Gao Tiansheng and Ma Xueli at Longdongxi in Ningqiang—the three were the fiercest bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 Yang Yuchun took Tingzhao at Anzigo and Tiansheng and Xueli at Longdongxi—the fiercest chiefs.

sentences.zh: 詔晉二等子，复雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: An edict advanced him to second-class viscount and restored double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: He was made second-class viscount and regained double peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 時賊之著者，陝西冉學勝、伍懷志，湖北徐天德、苟文明，四川樊人傑、冉天泗、王士虎等，尚不下十餘股。

translations.literal: At the time the notable bandits still at large included Ran Xuesheng and Wu Huaizhi in Shaanxi, Xu Tiande and Gou Wenming in Hubei, and Fan Renjie, Ran Tiansi, and Wang Shihu in Sichuan—more than ten bands in all.
translations.idiomatic: Notable bands still active included Xuesheng and Huaizhi in Shaanxi, Tiande and Wenming in Hubei, and Renjie, Tiansi, and Shihu in Sichuan—more than ten groups.

sentences.zh: 四月，剿學勝於渭河南岸，又蹙之於漢南，賊遁平利。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he suppressed Xuesheng on the south bank of the Wei and pressed him in southern Han; the bandits fled to Pingli.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 he beat Xuesheng south of the Wei and drove him toward Pingli.

sentences.zh: 張天倫糾合五路屯洵陽高塘嶺、劉家河，令楊遇春擊走之。

translations.literal: Zhang Tianlun gathered five routes at Gaotangling and Liuhe in Xunyang; he ordered Yang Yuchun to drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: Tianlun massed five bands at Xunyang; Yang Yuchun drove them off.

sentences.zh: 五月，穆克登布擒伍懷志於秦嶺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Mukedengbu captured Wu Huaizhi on the Qinling.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Mukedengbu took Wu Huaizhi on the Qinling.

sentences.zh: 七月，遇春擒冉天泗、王士虎於通江報曉埡，徐天德、冉學勝並為他師所殲；

translations.literal: In the seventh month Yuchun captured Ran Tiansi and Wang Shihu at Baoxiaoya in Tongjiang; Xu Tiande and Ran Xuesheng were destroyed by other armies;
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 Yuchun took Tiansi and Shihu at Baoxiaoya in Tongjiang; Tiande and Xuesheng fell to other commands;

sentences.zh: 而姚之富子馨佐及白號高見奇、辛斗等方擾寧羌，督諸將進剿，逼入川北。

translations.literal: but Yao Zhifu's son Xinzuo and the White-band Gao Jianqi, Xin Dou, and others were harassing Ningqiang; he directed the generals forward and drove them into northern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jianqi, Xin Dou, and Yao Zhifu's son Xinzuo still raided Ningqiang until driven into northern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 九月，總兵楊芳等擒辛鬥於通江。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Commander Yang Fang and others captured Xin Dou at Tongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 Yang Fang took Xin Dou at Tongjiang.

sentences.zh: 十月，豐伸、桑吉斯塔爾擒高見奇於達州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Feng Shen and Sangjisitaer captured Gao Jianqi at Dazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 Feng Shen and Sangjisitaer took Gao Jianqi at Dazhou.

sentences.zh: 於是賊首李元受、老教首閻天明等各率眾降，賊勢窮蹙。

translations.literal: Then bandit chiefs Li Yuanshou, the old teacher Yan Tianming, and others each led their followers to surrender, and rebel power was cornered.
translations.idiomatic: Chiefs including Li Yuanshou and Yan Tianming surrendered; the rebellion was cornered.

sentences.zh: 條上搜捕事宜，詔嘉獎，晉封三等伯。

translations.literal: He listed search-and-capture measures item by item; an edict praised and rewarded him and advanced him to third-class earl.
translations.idiomatic: His mop-up plan was praised and he was made third-class earl.

sentences.zh: 十一月，苟文明合各路殘匪竄階州，裹脅复眾，回竄廣元、通江。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Gou Wenming gathered remnant bands from every route and fled to Jiezhou, seized followers anew, and doubled back through Guangyuan and Tongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 Gou Wenming rallied remnants at Jiezhou, grew again, and doubled back through Guangyuan and Tongjiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，敗之於瓦山溪，文明竄開縣大寧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he defeated them at Washanxi; Wenming fled to Kaixian and Daning.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 he beat them at Washanxi; Wenming fled toward Daning.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，斬黃號辛聰於南江，文明由西鄉偷渡漢江。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year he beheaded the Yellow-band Xin Cong at Nanjiang; Wenming secretly crossed the Han at Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 7 he killed Xin Cong at Nanjiang; Wenming crossed the Han at Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保自請罪，降一等男，詔以川匪責德楞泰、勒保等，額勒登保兼西安將軍，仍專辦陝賊。

translations.literal: Eledengbao asked to be punished and was reduced one rank to second-class baron; an edict charged Sichuan bandits to Delengtai, Le Bao, and others, made Eledengbao also general at Xi'an, and still specialized in Shaanxi bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He asked punishment and was cut to second-class baron; Sichuan went to Delengtai and Le Bao while he kept Shaanxi as Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 二月，文明竄入南山，與宋應伏、劉永受合，督師入山搜剿。

translations.literal: In the second month Wenming entered the southern hills and joined Song Yingfu and Liu Yongshou; he led the army into the mountains to search and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 Wenming entered the southern hills with Song Yingfu and Liu Yongshou; Eledengbao searched the mountains.

sentences.zh: 六月，殲其眾於龔家灣，文明僅以身免，劉永受潛遁，為鄉民所殲。

translations.literal: In the sixth month their force was destroyed at Gongjiawan; Wenming alone escaped and Liu Yongshou slipped away but was killed by villagers.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 their host was destroyed at Gongjiawan; Wenming escaped and Yongshou was killed by villagers.

sentences.zh: 七月，殲文明於寧陝花石岩，晉一等伯。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Wenming was destroyed at Huashiyan in Ningshan and he was advanced to first-class earl.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 Wenming fell at Ningshan's Huashiyan and Eledengbao became first-class earl.

sentences.zh: 疏陳軍事將竣，請撤東三省及直隸、兩廣兵，遠地鄉勇分別遣留。

translations.literal: In a memorial he said military affairs were nearly concluded and asked to withdraw troops from the three eastern provinces and from Zhili, Guangdong, and Guangxi, and to send home or retain distant rural braves as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: He urged withdrawing troops from the northeast, Zhili, and the south, and disbanding or keeping distant militia as fit.

sentences.zh: 遂窮搜南山餘匪，八月，擒苟文齊，斃張芳。

translations.literal: He then searched out southern-hill remnant bandits to the end; in the eighth month he captured Gou Wenqi and killed Zhang Fang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 he took Gou Wenqi and killed Zhang Fang in the southern hills.

sentences.zh: 赴平利與德楞泰會剿楚匪，五戰，擒斬過半。

translations.literal: He went to Pingli to join Delengtai in suppressing Hubei bandits; in five battles more than half were captured or killed.
translations.idiomatic: At Pingli he joined Delengtai; five fights killed or captured more than half.

sentences.zh: 十月，斃青號熊方青於達州，盡殲竹溪股匪。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he killed the Green-band Xiong Fangqing at Dazhou and wholly destroyed the Zhuxi band.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 he killed Xiong Fangqing at Dazhou and wiped out the Zhuxi band.

sentences.zh: 十一月，令穆克登布追賊通江鐵鐙台，擒景英、蒲添香、賴大祥，及湖北老教首崔連樂，晉三等侯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he ordered Mukedengbu to pursue bandits at Tiedengtai in Tongjiang, capturing Jing Ying, Pu Tianxiang, Lai Daxiang, and the old Hubei teacher Cui Lianle; he was advanced to third-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 Mukedengbu took Jing Ying, Pu Tianxiang, Lai Daxiang, and Cui Lianle at Tongjiang; Eledengbao became third-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 著名匪首率就殲，零匪散竄老林。

translations.literal: Famous bandit chiefs were largely destroyed; scattered bandits fled into the great forest.
translations.idiomatic: Major chiefs were gone; stragglers hid in the great forest.

sentences.zh: 十二月，疏告蕆功，詔嘉額勒登保：「運籌決策，悉中機宜，躬親行陣，與士卒同甘苦，厥功最偉。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he memorialized that the task was complete; an edict praised Eledengbao: "In planning and decision all hit the mark; he went in person to the ranks and shared hardship with the soldiers—his merit is greatest."
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 he reported completion; the throne praised his strategy and sharing soldiers' hardships above all.

sentences.zh: 晉封一等侯，世襲罔替，授御前大臣，加太子太保，賜用紫韁。

translations.literal: He was advanced to first-class marquis with perpetual inheritance, made imperial attendant minister, given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent rank, and granted use of the purple bridle.
translations.idiomatic: He became perpetual first-class marquis, imperial attendant minister, Grand Guardian, with purple bridle privilege.

sentences.zh: 餘論封行賞有差。

translations.literal: The rest received differentiated enfeoffments, promotions, and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Others were enfeoffed and rewarded in due measure.

sentences.zh: 八年春，留陝搜捕，擒姚馨佐、陳文海、宋應伏等於紫陽。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighth year he remained in Shaanxi to search and capture, seizing Yao Xinzuo, Chen Wenhai, Song Yingfu, and others at Ziyang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 8 he stayed in Shaanxi and took Yao Xinzuo, Chen Wenhai, and Song Yingfu at Ziyang.

sentences.zh: 穆克登布遇伏戰歿。

translations.literal: Mukedengbu met an ambush and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Mukedengbu was ambushed and killed.

sentences.zh: 六月，移師入川，擒熊老八、趙金友於大寧，熊老八即戕穆克登布者。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he shifted troops into Sichuan and at Daning captured Xiong Laoba and Zhao Jinyou; Xiong Laoba was the man who had killed Mukedengbu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6 he entered Sichuan and at Daning took Xiong Laoba—Mukedengbu's killer—and Zhao Jinyou.

sentences.zh: 疏陳善後事宜：「各省酌留本省兵勇：四川一萬二千，湖北一萬，陝西一萬五千，分佈要地。

translations.literal: In a memorial on follow-up measures he said: "Each province should retain its own braves in due measure: Sichuan twelve thousand, Hubei ten thousand, Shaanxi fifteen thousand, posted at key points.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed garrisons of twelve thousand in Sichuan, ten thousand in Hubei, and fifteen thousand in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 隨徵鄉勇有業歸籍，無業補兵，分駐大員統率。」

translations.literal: Campaign rural braves with trades would return home; those without would be enrolled as soldiers under senior officers."
translations.idiomatic: Militia with trades went home; the rest became soldiers under senior commanders.

sentences.zh: 七月，馳奏肅清，命暫留四川經理善後。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he memorialized by rapid dispatch that the province was pacified and was ordered to remain temporarily in Sichuan to manage follow-up.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 he reported Sichuan clear and was told to stay for pacification.

sentences.zh: 編閱陝、楚營卡事竣，振旅還京。

translations.literal: When review of Shaanxi and Hubei garrison posts was finished, he led the army home in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: After reviewing Shaanxi and Hubei posts he marched home in triumph.

sentences.zh: 十二月，至，行抱見禮於養心殿，獎賚有加，命謁裕陵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he arrived; he was received in audience at the Hall of Mental Cultivation with the embrace-and-audience rite, richly rewarded, and ordered to pay respects at the Yuling mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 he reached Beijing, was embraced in audience at the Hall of Mental Cultivation, richly rewarded, and sent to Yuling.

sentences.zh: 九年春，因前遭母憂不獲守制，補持服。

translations.literal: In spring of the ninth year, because he had earlier been unable to observe mourning for his mother, he now completed the mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 9 he completed mourning he had earlier been unable to observe for his mother.

sentences.zh: 尋命赴四川偕德楞泰殲餘孽。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to Sichuan with Delengtai to destroy remnant bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent to Sichuan with Delengtai against remnants.

sentences.zh: 十年，回京，總理行營，充方略館總裁。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he returned to the capital, directed the field headquarters, and served as chief compiler of the Strategic Narrative Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he returned, directed the field headquarters, and headed the Strategic Narrative Office.

sentences.zh: 八月，上幸盛京，額勒登保以病不克從，謁陵禮成，特詔加恩晉三等公爵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Emperor went to Mukden; Eledengbao was too ill to accompany; when the tomb rites were done a special edict advanced him to third-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 the Emperor went to Mukden; too ill to follow, Eledengbao was advanced to third-class duke when the rites ended.

sentences.zh: 是月，卒於京師，年五十八。

translations.literal: That month he died in the capital at age fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: That month he died in Beijing at fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 上聞震悼，回鑾親奠，御製述悲詩一章。

translations.literal: On report the Emperor was deeply grieved; returning from Mukden he mourned in person and composed a poem of lament.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor grieved, returned from Mukden to mourn in person, and wrote a lament.

sentences.zh: 於地安門外建專祠，曰褒忠，諡忠毅，命吉林將軍修其祖墓立碑焉。

translations.literal: A special shrine called Baozhong was built outside Di'an Gate; he was given the posthumous title Zhongyi; the Jilin governor was ordered to repair his ancestral tomb and set up a stele.
translations.idiomatic: A Baozhong shrine was built outside Di'an Gate; his posthumous name was Zhongyi; Jilin was ordered to repair his ancestral tomb.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保初隸海蘭察部下，海蘭察謂曰：「子將才，宜略知古兵法。」

translations.literal: Eledengbao had first served under Hailancha; Hailancha said to him, "You have general's talent and should know something of ancient military methods."
translations.idiomatic: Under Hailancha he was told he had a general's talent and should learn ancient military methods.

sentences.zh: 以清文三國演義授之，由是曉暢戰事。

translations.literal: He gave him the Romance of the Three Kingdoms in Manchu, and from this he came to understand warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Hailancha gave him the Manchu Romance of the Three Kingdoms, and he mastered campaigning.

sentences.zh: 天性嚴毅，諸將白事，莫敢仰視。

translations.literal: By nature he was stern; when generals reported, none dared look up.
translations.idiomatic: He was stern; officers reporting dared not meet his eye.

sentences.zh: 然有功必拊循，戰勝親餉酒肉，賞巨萬不吝，人樂為用。

translations.literal: Yet when there was merit he always comforted men; after victory he personally fed them wine and meat and rewarded tens of thousands without stint—men were glad to serve him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he rewarded merit generously, feasted men after victory, and paid huge bonuses without stint.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂諸將曰：「兵條條生路，惟捨命進戰是一死路；

translations.literal: He once told the generals: "For soldiers every rule is a road to life—only staking life in attack is the road to death;
translations.idiomatic: He told his generals: "For troops every path is life except staking all on attack—that is death;

sentences.zh: 賊條條死路，惟捨命進戰是一生路。

translations.literal: for bandits every rule is a road to death—only staking life in attack is the road to life.
translations.idiomatic: for bandits every path is death except staking all on attack—that is life.

sentences.zh: 惟有出其不意、攻其不備之一法。

translations.literal: There is only the one method of striking where they do not expect and attacking where they are unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: Strike only where they do not expect.

sentences.zh: 追賊必窮所向，不使休息。

translations.literal: In pursuing bandits you must follow wherever they go and give them no rest.
translations.idiomatic: Never let pursued rebels rest.

sentences.zh: 師行整伍，倉卒遇賊，即擊。

translations.literal: On the march keep ranks in order; if bandits are met suddenly, strike at once.
translations.idiomatic: Keep order on the march; hit bandits the moment you meet them.

sentences.zh: 每宿，四路偵探；

translations.literal: Each night send scouts on four routes;
translations.idiomatic: Scout four ways every night;

sentences.zh: 臨敵，矢石從眉耳過，勿動。」

translations.literal: in battle, let arrows and stones pass by brow and ear—do not stir."
translations.idiomatic: in battle let arrows pass your brow and do not flinch."

sentences.zh: 於同列不忌功，亦不伐己功，尤嚴操守。

translations.literal: He did not begrudge credit to peers nor boast of his own, and was especially strict in personal integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He neither envied peers nor boasted, and was scrupulously honest.

sentences.zh: 凱旋過盧溝橋，他將輜重累累，獨行李蕭然，數騎而已。

translations.literal: Returning in triumph over Lugou Bridge, other generals had baggage trains piled high while he alone had sparse luggage—only a few mounted followers.
translations.idiomatic: At Lugou Bridge other generals trailed wagonloads; he had only a few horses.

sentences.zh: 歿時，子謨爾賡額生甫數月，帝臨奠，抱置膝上，命襲侯爵，尋殤，以侄哈郎阿嗣，承襲一等威勇侯，自有傳。

translations.literal: At his death his son Mo'ergeng had been born only months before; the Emperor mourned in person, set the child on his knee, ordered him to inherit the marquisate; the child soon died, and his nephew Halanga succeeded to the first-class Marquis Weiyong—recorded in his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His infant son Mo'ergeng was set on the Emperor's knee to inherit, soon died, and nephew Halanga succeeded as Marquis Weiyong.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保不識漢文，軍中章奏文牘，悉倚胡時顯。

translations.literal: Eledengbao could not read Chinese; all military memorials and documents in the army relied on Hu Shixian.
translations.idiomatic: Illiterate in Chinese, Eledengbao relied on Hu Shixian for all papers.

sentences.zh: 時顯，字行偕，江蘇武進人。

translations.literal: Shixian, styled Xingjie, was a native of Wujin in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shixian, courtesy name Xingjie, was from Wujin in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 少困科舉。

translations.literal: In youth he was frustrated in the civil service examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Youth brought frustration in the examinations.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，侍郎劉秉恬治金川糧餉，從司文牘獨勤。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign, when Vice Minister Liu Bingtian managed Jinchuan grain supplies, Shixian followed him handling documents alone and diligently.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liu Bingtian's Jinchuan supply office he alone handled documents diligently.

sentences.zh: 薦授兵部主事，充軍機章京，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: Recommended, he was appointed war secretary, served as Grand Council secretary, and was promoted repeatedly to director.
translations.idiomatic: He became war secretary, Grand Council secretary, and rose to director.

sentences.zh: 和珅用事，數與抗，出為廣東雷州知府，以親老乞留。

translations.literal: When Heshen held power he resisted him several times and was sent out as prefect of Leizhou in Guangdong, then begged to remain because of an aged parent.
translations.idiomatic: He defied Heshen, was posted to Leizhou, then stayed for an aged parent.

sentences.zh: 尋從福康安徵苗有功，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Fuk'ang'an against the Miao with merit and was granted peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Fuk'ang'an against the Miao and received peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 洎額勒登保剿教匪，從贊軍務，剛直無所徇，額勒登保能容之。

translations.literal: When Eledengbao suppressed sect rebels, Shixian followed to assist in military affairs; upright and unbending, Eledengbao could tolerate him.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Eledengbao's sect-rebel campaign; upright and fearless, he was tolerated.

sentences.zh: 每日跨馬與諸將偕，或有逗留，輒叱之。

translations.literal: Each day he rode with the generals; if any lingered he rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: Daily he rode with the generals and rebuked laggards.

sentences.zh: 遇賊務當其衝，諸將無敢卻者。

translations.literal: When bandits appeared he always took the brunt and no general dared hang back.
translations.idiomatic: He always took the brunt; no general dared hang back.

sentences.zh: 回營後，凡戰地曲折夷險，糧運斷續，器仗敝壞，兵卒勞飢，及賊出沒情狀，諸將功過，一一言之。

translations.literal: Back in camp he would recount every twist of terrain, every break in supply, every broken weapon, every hungry soldier, every bandit movement, and every general's merit or fault.
translations.idiomatic: After battle he reported terrain, supply, weapons, hunger, rebel moves, and every general's merit or fault.

sentences.zh: 軍中敬畏時顯與經略等。

translations.literal: The army feared Shixian as they did the supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: The army feared him almost as much as Eledengbao.

sentences.zh: 陳奏戰事必以實，上嘉經略，並嘉時顯。

translations.literal: His battle memorials were always truthful; the Emperor praised the supreme commander and also praised Shixian.
translations.idiomatic: His truthful memorials won praise alongside Eledengbao's.

sentences.zh: 貓兒埡之戰，及擒王登廷，章奏不欺，特賜三品卿銜。

translations.literal: At the battle of Mao'erya and the capture of Wang Dengting his memorials did not deceive; he was specially granted third-rank grand secretary rank.
translations.idiomatic: For Mao'erya and Dengting's capture his honest reports won third-rank grand secretary rank.

sentences.zh: 在軍凡五年，累擢內閣侍讀學士、鴻臚寺卿。

translations.literal: In the army five years in all, he was promoted repeatedly to Hanlin reader of the Grand Secretariat and minister of imperial banquets.
translations.idiomatic: In five years in the field he rose to Hanlin reader and minister of imperial banquets.

sentences.zh: 以勞卒於興安軍次，贈光祿寺卿，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: He died of exhaustion at Xing'an on campaign and was posthumously made minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with funeral honors.
translations.idiomatic: He died exhausted at Xing'an and was posthumously honored with sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰，字惇堂，伍彌特氏，正黃旗蒙古人。

translations.literal: Delengtai, styled Dundang, of the Uyimat clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai, courtesy name Dundang, was an Uyimat Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，以前鋒、藍翎長從征金川、石峰堡、台灣，皆有功，累遷參領，賜號繼勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign, as vanguard and blue-tasseled corporal he followed campaigns in Jinchuan, Shifengbao, and Taiwan with merit, was promoted to assistant commander, and granted the title Jiyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong he campaigned in Jinchuan, Shifengbao, and Taiwan, rose to assistant commander, and received Jiyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，從福康安徵廓爾喀，冒雨涉險，攻克熱索橋賊寨。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he followed Fuk'ang'an against Gurkha, braved rain and danger, and stormed the rebel stockade at Resuo Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In year 57 he stormed Resuo Bridge in the Gurkha campaign through rain and danger.

sentences.zh: 加副都統銜，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: He was given deputy banner commander rank and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Glories.
translations.idiomatic: He received deputy banner commander rank and a place in the Hall of Purple Glories.

sentences.zh: 尋授副都統，遷護軍統領。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed deputy banner commander and promoted to guard commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He became deputy banner commander, then guard commandant.

sentences.zh: 六十年，率巴圖魯侍衛從福康安徵湖南苗，與額勒登保並為軍鋒。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he led Baturu bodyguards with Fuk'ang'an against the Hunan Miao and with Eledengbao served as army vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In year 60 he led Baturu guards with Fuk'ang'an against the Hunan Miao beside Eledengbao as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 福康安既解松桃、永綏圍，高宗悅，將待以不次之賞，於是德楞泰建議深入苗地為犁庭埽穴計。

translations.literal: After Fuk'ang'an had relieved Songtao and Yongshun, the Gaozong Emperor was pleased and about to reward them beyond measure; Delengtai then proposed penetrating deep into Miao country to root out the lair.
translations.idiomatic: After Songtao and Yongshun were relieved, Delengtai proposed rooting out the Miao deep in their country.

sentences.zh: 苗酋吳半生踞大烏草河以抗，大兵連克沿河諸寨，渡河抵​​盛華哨。

translations.literal: The Miao chief Wu Bansheng held the Dawucao River in resistance; the great army took successive stockades along the river, crossed, and reached Shenghuashao.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bansheng held the Dawucao River; the army took stockades along it, crossed, and reached Shenghuashao.

sentences.zh: 苗於山半立木城，堅甚，斷其汲路，火攻克之，又克古丈坪，進攻摩手寨，由間道出寨後，奪據石城，遂偕額勒登保擒半生，授內大臣。

translations.literal: The Miao built a wooden fort halfway up the mountain, very strong; cutting their water route, they burned and took it, also took Guzhangping, advanced on Mosho stockade, went by a bypath behind the stockade, seized the stone fort, and with Eledengbao captured Bansheng; he was made inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: They burned a strong hillside wooden fort, took Guzhangping and Mosho by a rear path, and with Eledengbao captured Bansheng.

sentences.zh: 進攻鴨保寨，克木城、石卡三十餘，又克天星寨木城七，石卡五，擒賊目吳八月。

translations.literal: Advancing on Yabao stockade, he took more than thirty wooden forts and stone posts, also took seven wooden forts and five stone posts at Tianxing stockade, and captured the bandit leader Wu Babu.
translations.idiomatic: He took Yabao and Tianxing stockades, thirty wooden forts, and Wu Babu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，福康安、和琳相繼卒於軍，先克乾州，又從將軍明亮克平隴，擢御前侍衛，署領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing Fuk'ang'an and Helin died in succession in the army; he first recovered Qianzhou, then with General Mingliang took Pinglong, was promoted to imperial bodyguard, and acted as chief commandant of the imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 Fuk'ang'an and Helin died; he recovered Qianzhou, took Pinglong with Mingliang, and became acting chief bodyguard commandant.

sentences.zh: 克險隘養牛塘山梁，賊首石柳鄧就殲，苗疆略定，錫封二等子爵，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: He took the dangerous Yangniutang ridge; the bandit chief Shi Liudeng was destroyed; the Miao frontier was largely settled; he was enfeoffed as second-class viscount and granted double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: He took Yangniutang, destroyed Shi Liudeng, pacified the Miao frontier, and became second-class viscount with double peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 二年，命偕明亮移軍四川剿教匪。

translations.literal: In the second year he was ordered with Mingliang to shift troops to Sichuan to suppress sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he and Mingliang were sent to Sichuan against sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 時賊首徐天德、王三槐踞重石子、香爐坪，南曰分水嶺，北曰火石嶺，賊卡林立，進戰，奪嶺，三槐撲營受創逸。

translations.literal: Bandit chiefs Xu Tiande and Wang Sanhuai held Zhongshizi and Xiangluping; south was Fenshuiling and north Huoshiling, with bandit posts everywhere; in the advance they took the ridges and Sanhuai stormed the camp wounded and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande and Sanhuai held Zhongshizi and Xiangluping between Fenshuiling and Huoshiling; Sanhuai was wounded storming the camp.

sentences.zh: 五月，破重石子，明亮亦破香爐坪，追殲教首孫士鳳。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Zhongshizi was broken; Mingliang also broke Xiangluping; the sect chief Sun Shifeng was pursued and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 Zhongshizi and Xiangluping fell and Sun Shifeng was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 會襄陽賊齊王氏、姚之富、樊人傑等竄入四川，與徐、王二匪合屯開縣南天洞，擊破之，賊分走雲陽、萬縣。

translations.literal: Xiangyang bandits Qi Wangshi, Yao Zhifu, Fan Renjie, and others slipped into Sichuan and with Xu and Wang united at Nantian Cave in Kaixian; he broke them and the bandits split toward Yunyang and Wanxian.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Wangshi, Yao Zhifu, and Fan Renjie joined Xu and Wang at Kaixian's Nantian Cave; he broke them and they split toward Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 雲陽教首高名貴欲與天德合，以計擒之，盡殲其眾於陳家山。

translations.literal: The Yunyang sect chief Gao Minggui wished to join Tiande; by stratagem he was captured and his whole following destroyed at Chenjiashan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Minggui of Yunyang was lured in and destroyed at Chenjiashan.

sentences.zh: 七月，齊王氏等由奉節、巫山東走湖北，與明亮繞出宜昌迎剿，賊南趨，留明亮屯宜昌；

translations.literal: In the seventh month Qi Wangshi and others left through Fengjie and Wushan eastward into Hubei; with Mingliang he circled out through Yichang to intercept; the bandits turned south and he left Mingliang at Yichang;
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 the chiefs went east through Fengjie; he and Mingliang intercepted from Yichang, left Mingliang there,

sentences.zh: 自赴荊州解遠安圍。

translations.literal: he himself went to Jingzhou to relieve the Yuan'an siege.
translations.idiomatic: and he relieved Yuan'an at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，賊犯荊門、宜城，往援之，會總督景安以索倫勁騎至，合剿大捷，二城得全。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the bandits attacked Jingmen and Yicheng; he went to aid; Governor-General Jing An arrived with fierce Solon cavalry; joint suppression won a great victory and both cities were saved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 he saved Jingmen and Yicheng with Jing An's Solon cavalry.

sentences.zh: 賊欲北竄河南，扼要隘，斬賊目袁萬相等，截回湖北，賜紫韁。

translations.literal: The bandits wished to flee north into Henan; he held the passes, beheaded the bandit leader Yuan Wanxiang and others, and turned them back into Hubei; he was granted use of the purple bridle.
translations.idiomatic: He blocked their path to Henan, killed Yuan Wanxiang, turned them back into Hubei, and received purple bridle privilege.

sentences.zh: 九月，殲賊於房縣、竹谿、竹山，賊走陝西平利，圖入川東，敗之樹河口。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he destroyed bandits at Fangxian, Zhuxi, and Zhushan; the bandits fled to Pingli in Shaanxi intending eastern Sichuan and were defeated at Shuhekou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 he cleared Fangxian, Zhuxi, and Zhushan; survivors were beaten at Shuhekou.

sentences.zh: 賊北走紫陽，又合白號高均德，西走漢中。

translations.literal: The bandits went north to Ziyang and again joined the White-band Gao Junde, then went west to Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: They went to Ziyang, joined Gao Junde, and moved west to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 十一月，賊窺渡漢江，令副都統烏爾圖納遜突擊於江濱，竄入川境。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the bandits sought to cross the Han; he ordered Deputy Banner Commander Wurtunai to strike suddenly at the riverbank and they fled into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 Wurtunai struck them at the Han and drove them into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，均德复擾陝西褒城，與明亮夾擊，連敗之於洋縣、城固、洵陽。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Junde again harassed Bao Prefecture in Shaanxi; with Mingliang he attacked from both sides and repeatedly defeated them at Yangxian, Chenggu, and Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 3 he and Mingliang beat Junde at Yangxian, Chenggu, and Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 齊王氏、姚之富方竄廣元寧羌山中，乘虛由石泉渡漢，與均德合，東走漢陰。

translations.literal: Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu were then lurking in the mountains of Guangyuan and Ningqiang; seizing the chance they crossed the Han at Shiquan and joined Junde, going east to Hanyin.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu crossed at Shiquan, joined Junde, and went to Hanyin.

sentences.zh: 詔斥明亮戰不力，褫其職；

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Mingliang for weak fighting and stripped his office;
translations.idiomatic: Mingliang was stripped for weak fighting;

sentences.zh: 嘉德楞泰每戰在前，責速剿。

translations.literal: Delengtai was praised for fighting in the van each battle and ordered to suppress quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai was praised for leading every fight and ordered to hurry.

sentences.zh: 三月，與明亮追齊、姚二匪，由山陽至鄖西，日行百七十里，連破之於石河、甘溝，鄉勇遏其前，賊無去路，踞三岔河左右，兩山盡銳，圍攻悉殲之。

translations.literal: In the third month with Mingliang he pursued Qi and Yao from Shanyang to Yunxi, marching a hundred and seventy li a day, repeatedly defeating them at Shihe and Gangou; militia blocked the front so the bandits had no escape and held both banks of Sancha River with all their strength; encircled and attacked, all were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 he pursued Qi and Yao a hundred and seventy li a day to Sancha River and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 齊王氏、姚之富投崖死，傳首三省。

translations.literal: Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu threw themselves from the cliffs and died; their heads were sent through the three provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Wangshi and Yao Zhifu died on the cliffs; their heads were sent through three provinces.

sentences.zh: 均德由鎮安竄雒南，敗之兩岔河，餘賊與李全、張天倫合。

translations.literal: Junde fled from Zhen'an to Luonan; he was defeated at Liangcha River; remnant bandits joined Li Quan and Zhang Tianlun.
translations.idiomatic: Junde fled to Luonan, was beaten at Liangcha River, and remnants joined Li Quan and Tianlun.

sentences.zh: 五月，又敗之五郎廟，均德走寧羌、廣元，合龍紹週、冉文儔踞渠縣大神山，有眾二萬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was again defeated at Wulangmiao; Junde fled to Ningqiang and Guangyuan and with Long Shaozhou and Ran Wencong held Dashen Mountain in Quxian with twenty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 he lost at Wulangmiao; Junde joined Long Shaozhou and Ran Wencong on Dashen Mountain with twenty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 詔斥縱賊，奪爵職，留副都統銜。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him for letting bandits escape, stripped his title and office, and left him deputy banner commander rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was stripped for letting rebels escape but kept deputy banner commander rank.

sentences.zh: 七月，偕惠齡、恆瑞攻克大神山，賊竄營山，蹙之黃渡河。

translations.literal: In the seventh month with Hui Ling and Hengrui he stormed Dashen Mountain; the bandits fled to Yingshan and were pressed to Huangdu River.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 he took Dashen Mountain; the rebels fled to Yingshan and Huangdu River.

sentences.zh: 均德中槍，逸入箕山坪，與羅其清合。

translations.literal: Junde was shot, escaped to Jishanping, and joined Luo Qiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Junde was wounded, fled to Jishanping, and joined Luo Qiqing.

sentences.zh: 箕山圍徑百餘裡，三面陡絕，惟東南有路可通。

translations.literal: The Jishan encirclement was over a hundred li; three sides were sheer cliff; only the southeast had a passable road.
translations.idiomatic: Jishan was a hundred-li trap with only a southeast exit.

sentences.zh: 徐天德、王登廷、樊人傑踞鳳凰寺，阻糧道，與為犄角。

translations.literal: Xu Tiande, Wang Dengting, and Fan Renjie held Fenghuang Temple, blocking the grain route, in mutual support.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande, Dengting, and Renjie held Fenghuang Temple and blocked supplies.

sentences.zh: 八月，克鳳凰寺，賊奔箕山，負固不下。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Fenghuang Temple was taken; the bandits fled to Jishan and held out stubbornly.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 Fenghuang Temple fell; the rebels held stubbornly on Jishan.

sentences.zh: 十月，分三路進攻，克之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he attacked on three routes and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 a three-route assault took Jishan.

sentences.zh: 其清退踞大鵬寨，額勒登保自閬中來會剿。

translations.literal: Qiqing retreated to Dapeng stockade; Eledengbao came from Langzhong to join the suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqing retreated to Dapeng; Eledengbao came from Langzhong.

sentences.zh: 十一月，賊被攻急，乘夜雨撲營。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, pressed hard, the bandits on a rainy night stormed the camp.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, pressed hard, they night-attacked in rain.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰偵知之，潛伏賊寨南門，梯而登，火其寨；

translations.literal: Delengtai learned of it, lay in ambush at the south gate of the bandit stockade, scaled the wall, and burned the stockade;
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai ambushed the south gate, scaled in, and burned the stockade;

sentences.zh: 額勒登保等亦襲破西門，殲其清父從國；

translations.literal: Eledengbao and others also stormed the west gate and destroyed Qiqing's father Congguo;
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao stormed the west gate and killed Qiqing's father Congguo;

sentences.zh: 合兵窮追，擒其清於巴州方山坪，复花翎。

translations.literal: uniting their forces they pursued to the end, captured Qiqing at Fangshanping in Bazhou, and peacock feathers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: together they took Qiqing at Fangshanping and Delengtai regained his feathers.

sentences.zh: 冉文儔竄踞東鄉麻壩，乘除夕大破之於通江。

translations.literal: Ran Wencong lurked at Maba in Dongxiang; on New Year's Eve he was heavily defeated at Tongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ran Wencong at Dongxiang's Maba was crushed at Tongjiang on New Year's Eve.

sentences.zh: 四年元旦，生擒文儔，盡殲其眾，予一等輕車都尉。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day of the fourth year Wencong was captured alive and his whole following destroyed; he was given first-class commandant of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day of year 4 Wencong was taken alive and his band destroyed; Delengtai became first-class commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 經略勒保疏陳諸將惟額勒登保、德楞泰尤知兵，得士心，詔德楞泰專剿徐天德。

translations.literal: Supreme Commander Le Bao memorialized that among the generals only Eledengbao and Delengtai especially understood warfare and won soldiers' hearts; an edict ordered Delengtai to specialize in suppressing Xu Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao named Eledengbao and Delengtai as the ablest generals; Delengtai was ordered to hunt Xu Tiande.

sentences.zh: 天德與冷天祿竄涪州，冒難民入鶴田寨，擊走之，又敗之於開縣。

translations.literal: Tiande with Leng Tianlu fled to Fuzhou, entered Hetian stockade disguised as refugees, were driven off, and were again defeated at Kaixian.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande and Tianlu entered Hetian stockade as refugees, were driven off, and beaten again at Kaixian.

sentences.zh: 三月，天德自大寧北趨，追及於太平；

translations.literal: In the third month Tiande went north from Daning; pursuit caught up at Taiping;
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 Tiande left Daning northward; pursuit caught him at Taiping;

sentences.zh: 又遇龍紹週、唐大信等，迭擊之，賊不得犯陝境。

translations.literal: he also met Long Shaozhou, Tang Daxin, and others and defeated them in succession so the bandits could not enter Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: he beat Long Shaozhou and Tang Daxin and kept them out of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 既而天德入大寧老林，與紹週、大信及樊人傑、龔建、卜三聘、張天倫、辛聰等合，牽綴大軍。

translations.literal: Soon Tiande entered the great forest of Daning and joined Shaozhou, Daxin, Fan Renjie, Gong Jian, Bu Sanpin, Zhang Tianlun, Xin Cong, and others, tying down the main armies.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande entered Daning's great forest, joined Shaozhou, Daxin, Renjie, and others, and tied down the armies.

sentences.zh: 天德、建竄太平山箐，令賽衝阿分兵擊之；

translations.literal: Tiande and Jian fled to Taipingshan gorge; he ordered Saichong'a to divide troops and strike them;
translations.idiomatic: Tiande and Jian fled to Taipingshan; Saichong'a was sent against them;

sentences.zh: 自擊人傑、紹週、大信、天倫於安康、紫陽，連破之，驅入川東，遂犯湖北。

translations.literal: he himself struck Renjie, Shaozhou, Daxin, and Tianlun at Ankang and Ziyang, repeatedly defeated them, drove them into eastern Sichuan, and they then invaded Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: he beat Renjie, Shaozhou, Daxin, and Tianlun in Ankang and Ziyang and drove them east into Hubei.

sentences.zh: 七月，線號龔文玉亦自夔州至，分兵追剿，擒文玉、三聘於竹谿，加予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Red-band Gong Wenyu also came from Kuizhou; troops were divided in pursuit; Wenyu and Sanpin were captured at Zhuxi; he was given hereditary commandant of cavalry rank.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 Gong Wenyu came from Kuizhou; Wenyu and Sanpin were taken at Zhuxi; he received hereditary cavalry commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 八月，命額勒登保為經略，德楞泰為參贊，赴興山截擊天德，逼回川東；

translations.literal: In the eighth month Eledengbao was made supreme commander and Delengtai deputy; they went to Xingshan to intercept Tiande and drove him back to eastern Sichuan;
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 Eledengbao became supreme commander and Delengtai deputy; they drove Tiande back from Xingshan;

sentences.zh: 躡追天倫及聰等入陝。

translations.literal: pursuit followed Tianlun, Cong, and others into Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: and pursued Tianlun and Cong into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十月，高均德改名郝以智，率賊萬，踞高家營，欲由白河窺渡漢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Gao Junde changed his name to Hao Yizhi, led ten thousand bandits, and held Gaojia camp intending to cross the Han at Baihe.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 Gao Junde renamed himself Hao Yizhi, held Gaojia camp with ten thousand men, and aimed to cross the Han at Baihe.

sentences.zh: 紹週及冉天元竄放馬場，欲趨紫陽。

translations.literal: Shaozhou and Ran Tianyuan lurked at Fangmachang intending to rush Ziyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou and Tianyuan lurked at Fangmachang toward Ziyang.

sentences.zh: 率賽衝阿、溫春回援，先破放馬場，進攻高家營，擒均德，檻送京師，晉封二等男爵。

translations.literal: He led Saichong'a and Wenchun back to aid, first broke Fangmachang, then attacked Gaojia camp, captured Junde, and sent him in the cangue to the capital; he was advanced to second-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: With Saichong'a and Wenchun he took Fangmachang and Gaojia camp, captured Junde, and was made second-class baron.

sentences.zh: 十一月，進兵川北，殲白號張金魁於通江，擒其黨符曰明等於廣元。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he advanced into northern Sichuan, destroyed the White-band Zhang Jinkui at Tongjiang, and captured his partisans Fu Yueming and others at Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11 he destroyed Zhang Jinkui at Tongjiang and took Fu Yueming at Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，追鮮大川、苟文明至川東，賊瞷大兵俱在川境，遂先後竄陝、甘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he pursued Xian Dachuan and Gou Wenming to eastern Sichuan; the bandits, seeing the main armies all in Sichuan, then slipped into Shaanxi and Gansu in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 he pursued Dachuan and Wenming east; seeing armies in Sichuan, they slipped into Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，偕額勒登保分路抵秦州，而冉天元糾合徐萬富、汪瀛、陳得俸、張子聰、雷世旺眾五萬，遽乘間渡嘉陵江，分擾南部、西充、魁倫不能制，詔促德楞泰回援。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, with Eledengbao on separate routes he reached Qinzhou; but Ran Tianyuan gathered Xu Wanfu, Wang Ying, Chen Defu, Zhang Zicong, and Lei Shiwang—fifty thousand in all—suddenly crossed the Jialing on the chance and raided Nanbu, Xichong, and beyond; Kuilun could not control them; an edict urgently ordered Delengtai back to aid.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 5 he reached Qinzhou with Eledengbao while Tianyuan crossed the Jialing with fifty thousand; Kuilun failed and Delengtai was recalled.

sentences.zh: 二月，天元踞江油新店子，乃由間道進剿。

translations.literal: In the second month Tianyuan held Xindianzi in Jiangyou; he advanced to suppress by a bypath.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 Tianyuan held Xindianzi in Jiangyou; Delengtai advanced by a hidden route.

sentences.zh: 賊分四路迎戰，銳甚，賽衝阿、溫春深入被圍；

translations.literal: The bandits met on four routes to fight, very fierce; Saichong'a and Wenchun advanced deep and were surrounded;
translations.idiomatic: Four rebel columns fought fiercely; Saichong'a and Wenchun were surrounded;

sentences.zh: 自馳援，夾擊竟日，殺傷相當，擒得俸，斬冉天恆，皆悍賊也。

translations.literal: he himself raced to aid; pincer attacks lasted all day; casualties were about equal; Defu was captured and Ran Tianheng beheaded—both fierce bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He rescued them in a day-long fight, took Defu, and killed Ran Tianheng.

sentences.zh: 轉戰連奪險隘。

translations.literal: Turning to battle he seized dangerous passes in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He then took pass after pass.

sentences.zh: 三月，天元屯馬蹄岡，伏萬人火石埡後。

translations.literal: In the third month Tianyuan encamped at Matigang with ten thousand men in ambush behind Huoshi'ya.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3 Tianyuan held Matigang with ten thousand ambushers at Huoshi'ya.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰令賽衝阿攻包家溝，阿哈保攻火石埡，溫春攻龍子觀，自率大隊趨馬蹄岡，過賊伏數重始覺。

translations.literal: Delengtai ordered Saichong'a to attack Baojiagou, Ahabao Huoshi'ya, Wenchun Longziguan, and himself led the main force toward Matigang, passing several ambushes before realizing.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Saichong'a, Ahabao, and Wenchun on three axes and led the main body toward Matigang through hidden ambushes.

sentences.zh: 俄伏起，八路來攻，人持束竹、濕絮禦箭銃，鏖斗三晝夜，賊更番迭進，數路皆挫敗。

translations.literal: Soon the ambush rose; eight routes attacked; each man held bundled bamboo and wet cotton against arrows and guns; they fought three days and nights; the bandits rotated attacks in waves and several routes were beaten back.
translations.idiomatic: Ambushers rose on eight routes with bamboo and wet cotton against shot; three days and nights of fighting repulsed several columns.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰率親兵數十，下馬據山巔，誓必死。

translations.literal: Delengtai with several dozen personal guards dismounted and held the mountain crest, swearing to die.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai with dozens of guards held the summit and swore to die there.

sentences.zh: 天元督眾登山，直取德楞泰，德楞泰單騎衝賊中堅，將士隨之，大呼奮擊，天元馬中矢蹶，擒之，賊遂瓦解。

translations.literal: Tianyuan led the masses up the mountain straight at Delengtai; Delengtai charged alone into the rebel center, troops followed, shouting and striking fiercely; Tianyuan's horse was hit by an arrow and fell; he was captured and the bandits collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyuan charged the summit; Delengtai rode into the rebel center, Tianyuan's horse fell, he was captured, and the rebels collapsed.

sentences.zh: 鄉勇亦自山後至，逐北二十餘裡，擒斬無算。

translations.literal: Militia also came from behind the mountain; pursuit northward over twenty li killed and captured beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Militia struck from the rear; twenty li of pursuit killed countless rebels.

sentences.zh: 天元雄黠冠川賊，專用伏以陷官軍，至是五日四戰，致死決勝負，血戰破之，群賊奪氣，詔晉三等子。

translations.literal: Tianyuan was the craftiest of Sichuan bandits and specialized in ambush to trap government troops; now in five days and four battles he fought to the death to decide the issue; bloody fighting broke him and all bandits lost heart; an edict advanced him to third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyuan, Sichuan's craftiest ambusher, was broken in four fights in five days; Delengtai became third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 是月，復大破賊於劍州，又破張子聰、雷世旺於蓬溪，斬世旺，晉二等子，授成都將軍。

translations.literal: That month he again heavily defeated bandits at Jianzhou and broke Zhang Zicong and Lei Shiwang at Pengxi, beheading Shiwang; he was advanced to second-class viscount and made general at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month he won at Jianzhou and Pengxi, killed Shiwang, became second-class viscount and Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 魁倫以失守潼河逮問，起勒保代為總督，與德楞泰合兵勦賊。

translations.literal: Kuilun was arrested for losing the Tong River; Le Bao was recalled to replace him as governor-general and joined Delengtai to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilun was arrested; Le Bao replaced him and joined Delengtai.

sentences.zh: 四月，賊分擾遂寧、安岳，逼中江，欲趨成都。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the bandits raided Suining and Anyue, pressed Zhongjiang, and aimed at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 rebels raided toward Chengdu through Suining and Zhongjiang.

sentences.zh: 與勒保夾擊，連破之，邀擊於嘉陵江口，俘斬溺斃者數千；

translations.literal: Pincer attacks with Le Bao repeatedly broke them; they were intercepted at the Jialing mouth and thousands were captured, killed, or drowned;
translations.idiomatic: With Le Bao he beat them repeatedly and killed thousands at the Jialing mouth;

sentences.zh: 餘賊渡江，為達州鄉勇所敗，擒汪瀛：潼河兩岸肅清。

translations.literal: the rest crossed the river and were defeated by Dazhou militia; Wang Ying was captured: both banks of the Tong were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Survivors were beaten by Dazhou militia and Wang Ying was taken; the Tong was cleared.

sentences.zh: 自此德楞泰威震川中，諸將往往假其旗幟，賊望見輒走。

translations.literal: From this Delengtai's prestige shook Sichuan; generals often used his banner and bandits fled at sight.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai's name alone now made rebels flee in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 閏四月，追賊至達州、新寧，殲劉君聘、苟文富；

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month pursuit reached Dazhou and Xining and destroyed Liu Junpin and Gou Wenfu;
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 4 he destroyed Liu Junpin and Gou Wenfu at Dazhou;

sentences.zh: 而白號苟文明、鮮大川、樊人傑等復由陝入川。

translations.literal: but the White-band Gou Wenming, Xian Dachuan, Fan Renjie, and others again entered Sichuan from Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wenming, Dachuan, and Renjie re-entered from Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 五月，移師川北，賊走營山、渠縣，六月，敗之恩陽河；

translations.literal: In the fifth month he shifted to northern Sichuan; bandits fled to Yingshan and Quxian; in the sixth month he defeated them at Enyang River;
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 he moved north; in month 6 he beat them at Enyang River;

sentences.zh: 又與勒保合擊，殲苟文禮於岳池。

translations.literal: again with Le Bao he jointly struck and destroyed Gou Wenli at Yuechi.
translations.idiomatic: with Le Bao he destroyed Gou Wenli at Yuechi.

sentences.zh: 七月，大川為民寨誘斬，文明遁。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Dachuan was lured and beheaded by a civilian stockade; Wenming escaped.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 Dachuan was killed by a stockade trap; Wenming escaped.

sentences.zh: 八月，追剿白號賊於東鄉，殲湯思舉，餘賊與趙麻花、王珊合。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he pursued White-band bandits at Dongxiang, destroyed Tang Siju, and the remainder joined Zhao Mahua and Wang Shan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 he destroyed Tang Siju at Dongxiang; survivors joined Mahua and Shan.

sentences.zh: 九月，與勒保夾擊於雲陽，麻花、珊先後斃。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he and Le Bao struck together at Yunyang; Mahua and Shan were successively killed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 he and Le Bao killed Mahua and Shan at Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 十月，湖北黃、白、藍、線四號賊合犯夔、巫。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Hubei Yellow, White, Blue, and Red bands united and attacked Kuizhou and Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10 four Hubei bands attacked Kuizhou and Wu.

sentences.zh: 龍紹週由太平、通江北竄，兵至賊去，兵去賊至；

translations.literal: Long Shaozhou slipped north through Taiping and Tongjiang; when troops came the bandits left, when troops left the bandits came;
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou eluded pursuit between Taiping and Tongjiang;

sentences.zh: 樊人傑、冉學勝、王士虎遂由川入陝；

translations.literal: Fan Renjie, Ran Xuesheng, and Wang Shihu then entered Shaanxi from Sichuan;
translations.idiomatic: Renjie, Xuesheng, and Shihu entered Shaanxi;

sentences.zh: 徐天德由陝入楚。

translations.literal: Xu Tiande entered Hubei from Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Tiande entered Hubei from Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 詔斥德楞泰堵剿不力，降一等男。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Delengtai for weak blocking and chasing and reduced him one rank to second-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: He was rebuked for weak blocking and cut to second-class baron.

sentences.zh: 十二月，李彬、楊開第、齊國謨合窺嘉陵江。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Li Bin, Yang Kaidi, and Qi Guomo united to probe the Jialing.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 Li Bin, Kaidi, and Guomo probed the Jialing.

sentences.zh: 與勒保合擊，連敗之於渠縣安仁溪、儀隴觀音河，斃開第、國謨，晉三等子。

translations.literal: Joint strikes with Le Bao repeatedly defeated them at Anrenxi in Quxian and Guanyinhe in Yilong, killing Kaidi and Guomo; he was advanced to third-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: With Le Bao he killed Kaidi and Guomo and became third-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，白號高天升自洵陽偷渡漢江，圖竄河南，追及於山陽乾溝，破之，追殲之於野豬坪，復一等子。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year the White-band Gao Tiansheng secretly crossed the Han at Xunyang intending Henan; pursuit caught him at Qiangou in Shanyang, broke him, and hunted him to destruction at Yezhuping; he was restored to first-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 6 Gao Tiansheng crossed the Han toward Henan; he was destroyed at Yezhuping and Delengtai regained first-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 二月，擊龍紹週於興安，逼入川境，連敗之於大寧長壩、二郎壩。

translations.literal: In the second month he struck Long Shaozhou at Xing'an, pressed him into Sichuan, and repeatedly defeated him at Changba and Erlangba in Daning.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 he drove Shaozhou from Xing'an into Daning and beat him twice.

sentences.zh: 紹週竄湖北竹山、房縣，复敗之，走太平，复雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: Shaozhou fled to Zhushan and Fangxian in Hubei, was beaten again, fled to Taiping, and peacock feathers were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou fled to Hubei, was beaten again at Taiping, and regained his feathers.

sentences.zh: 四月，徐天德、樊人傑合曾芝秀、陳朝觀竄陝西白河，分擾民寨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Xu Tiande and Fan Renjie with Zeng Zhixiu and Chen Chaoguan fled to Baihe in Shaanxi and raided civilian stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 Tiande and Renjie with Zhixiu and Chaoguan raided Baihe stockades.

sentences.zh: 遣兵直攻其巢，擒朝觀。

translations.literal: He sent troops straight at their lair and captured Chaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed their lair and took Chaoguan.

sentences.zh: 五月，大破賊於西鄉，天德竄紫陽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he heavily defeated bandits at Xixiang; Tiande fled to Ziyang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 he crushed them at Xixiang; Tiande fled to Ziyang.

sentences.zh: 率賽衝阿、溫春蹙之仁和新灘。

translations.literal: He led Saichong'a and Wenchun to press them at Renhe and Xintan.
translations.idiomatic: Saichong'a and Wenchun pressed him at Renhe and Xintan.

sentences.zh: 大雨水漲，天德溺斃。

translations.literal: Heavy rain swelled the waters and Tiande drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Floods drowned Tiande.

sentences.zh: 紹週乘虛闌入房縣、竹谿，截擊之，復回太平，擒其黨陳文明。

translations.literal: Shaozhou seized the chance to slip into Fangxian and Zhuxi; he intercepted, Shaozhou again fled to Taiping, and his partisan Chen Wenming was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozhou slipped into Fangxian; Delengtai intercepted and took Chen Wenming.

sentences.zh: 八月，追至巫山、巴東，擒王鵬、李天棟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month pursuit reached Wushan and Badong and captured Wang Peng and Li Tiandong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 he took Wang Peng and Li Tiandong at Wushan and Badong.

sentences.zh: 九月，紹週遁平利，令賽衝阿等追殲之，晉封二等繼勇伯，仍用巴圖魯舊號也。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Shaozhou escaped to Pingli; he ordered Saichong'a and others to pursue and destroy him; he was advanced to second-class Earl Jiyong, still using the old Batulu title.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9 Shaozhou was destroyed at Pingli; Delengtai became Earl Jiyong.

sentences.zh: 十二月，苟文明西擾寧羌，與額勒登保夾擊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Gou Wenming raided west into Ningqiang; he and Eledengbao struck from both sides.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12 Wenming raided Ningqiang; he and Eledengbao struck together.

sentences.zh: 賊竄川北，大敗之於通江，走開縣，遣兵追之。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to northern Sichuan; he heavily defeated them at Tongjiang; they fled to Kaixian and he sent troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: He beat them at Tongjiang; they fled to Kaixian.

sentences.zh: 自率輕騎赴大寧，斷其入楚之路。

translations.literal: He himself led light cavalry to Daning to cut their path into Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He raced to Daning to block their path into Hubei.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，文明復入陝北，竄老林，至秋，乃為陝軍所殲。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year Wenming again entered northern Shaanxi and lurked in the great forest; only in autumn was he destroyed by Shaanxi troops.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1 of year 7 Wenming hid in the great forest until autumn when Shaanxi troops destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 川東零匪猶四擾，詔德楞泰仍專辦川賊。

translations.literal: Scattered bandits still raided in four directions in eastern Sichuan; an edict ordered Delengtai still to specialize in Sichuan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sichuan still had scattered bands; Delengtai kept Sichuan command.

sentences.zh: 二月，破線號餘匪於奉節，又破白號張長青於雲陽。

translations.literal: In the second month he broke Red remnant bandits at Fengjie and White-band Zhang Changqing at Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2 he broke Red remnants at Fengjie and Zhang Changqing at Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 時樊人傑及崔宗和、胡明遠、戴仕傑、蒲天寶等麕聚湖北境。

translations.literal: At the time Fan Renjie and Cui Zonghe, Hu Mingyuan, Dai Shijie, Pu Tianbao, and others massed on the Hubei border.
translations.idiomatic: Renjie, Zonghe, Mingyuan, Shijie, and Tianbao massed on the Hubei border.

sentences.zh: 四月，率精兵間道抵東湖，繞出賊前，夾攻雞公山賊巢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he led picked troops by a bypath to Donghu, circled ahead of the bandits, and pincer-attacked the Jigong Mountain lair.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4 he outflanked the Jigong Mountain lair from Donghu.

sentences.zh: 天寶別屯當陽河，五月，冒雨進擊，天寶負創走，又敗之於穆家溝，分兵留剿；

translations.literal: Tianbao held separately at Dangyang River; in the fifth month he attacked through rain; Tianbao was wounded and fled; he was again defeated at Mujiagou and troops were left to suppress;
translations.idiomatic: In month 5 he wounded Tianbao at Dangyang River and beat him at Mujiagou;

sentences.zh: 自移師東趨，直取人傑，冒雨入馬鹿坪山中，出賊不意，痛殲之。

translations.literal: he himself shifted east, went straight at Renjie, entered Maping Mountain in the rain by surprise, and destroyed them painfully.
translations.idiomatic: he then surprised Renjie in Maping Mountain in the rain.

sentences.zh: 人傑竄竹山，投水死。

translations.literal: Renjie fled to Zhushan and drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: Renjie drowned himself at Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 人傑倡亂最久，諸賊聽指揮，與冉天元埒，至是伏誅，晉三等侯。

translations.literal: Renjie had stirred rebellion longest; all bandits obeyed his command, equal to Ran Tianyuan; now he was executed; he was advanced to third-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Renjie, longest-led of the chiefs, was dead; Delengtai became third-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 七月，天寶乘間奪踞興山、房縣交界鮑家山，死守抗拒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Tianbao seized Baojiashan on the Xingshan-Fangxian border and held out stubbornly.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7 Tianbao held Baojiashan stubbornly.

sentences.zh: 以大軍綴其前，令總兵色爾袞、蒲尚佐率精兵出深箐攻賊巢，截其去路，擒斬殆盡。

translations.literal: With the main army pinning the front he ordered Commander Se'ergun and Pu Shangzuo to lead picked troops through deep ravines to strike the lair and cut escape; nearly all were captured or killed.
translations.idiomatic: Se'ergun and Pu Shangzuo stormed the rear while the main force pinned the front.

sentences.zh: 天寶遁，至竹谿墜崖死。

translations.literal: Tianbao fled, reached Zhuxi, and fell from a cliff to his death.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao fell to his death on a Zhuxi cliff.

sentences.zh: 時巴東、興山尚有餘匪，皆百戰之餘，悉官軍號令及老林路迳，屢合圍，輒乘霧溜崖突竄。

translations.literal: At the time remnant bandits remained in Badong and Xingshan—all veterans of a hundred battles who knew government signals and great-forest paths; repeatedly encircled, they would break out in fog down cliffs.
translations.idiomatic: Badong and Xingshan remnants knew every forest path and broke encirclements in fog.

sentences.zh: 分軍遇之則不利，大隊趨之則兔脫，所餘無幾，而三省不能解嚴。

translations.literal: Separate detachments fared badly against them; large columns found them gone like rabbits—only a few remained yet three provinces could not stand down.
translations.idiomatic: Small parties lost; large columns found them gone—few remained, yet three provinces stayed mobilized.

sentences.zh: 與額勒登保、吳熊光會於竹谿議搜剿，額勒登保專任陝境，德楞泰專任楚境，先後殲戴仕傑、趙鑑、崔連洛、崔宗和、陳仕學、熊翠諸賊，迨十一月，捕斬略盡，優詔，晉封一等侯，加太子太保，命其子蘇衝阿★K7珍賚至軍宣慰。

translations.literal: Meeting Eledengbao and Wu Xiongguang at Zhuxi to plan search and suppression, Eledengbao took Shaanxi and Delengtai Hubei; Dai Shijie, Zhao Jian, Cui Lianluo, Cui Zonghe, Chen Shixue, Xiong Cui, and other bandits were successively destroyed; by the eleventh month capture and killing were largely complete; a favorable edict advanced him to first-class marquis, Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and ordered his son Suchong'a with imperial gifts to the army to announce rewards.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhuxi with Eledengbao he divided Shaanxi and Hubei; by month 11 the hunt was nearly done; he became first-class marquis and Suchong'a brought imperial gifts to the army.

sentences.zh: 八年，駐巫山、大寧，捕逸匪曾芝秀、冉璠、張士虎、趙聰等，先後擒殲。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he garrisoned Wushan and Daning, capturing fugitive bandits Zeng Zhixiu, Ran Fan, Zhang Shihu, Zhao Cong, and others in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 at Wushan and Daning he took Zhixiu, Fan, Shihu, and Cong.

sentences.zh: 至冬事竣，入覲熱河行在，帝大悅，御製詩賜之，恩賚優渥。

translations.literal: When winter work was done he came to audience at the Rehe traveling palace; the Emperor was greatly pleased, composed a poem and bestowed it, and rewards were exceptionally generous.
translations.idiomatic: He attended at Rehe; the Emperor composed a poem and gave lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 尋以陝西南山餘孽擾及川境，命回鎮成都。

translations.literal: Soon southern-hill remnant bandits in Shaanxi troubled the Sichuan border; he was ordered back to garrison Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi remnants troubled Sichuan; he returned to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 遣將招降，數為賊害，坐降二等侯。

translations.literal: He sent generals to induce surrender but several were killed by bandits; he was demoted one rank to second-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Surrender envoys were killed; he was cut to second-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕額勒登保窮搜老林，斬首逆苟文潤，餘匪悉平，復一等侯。

translations.literal: In the ninth year with Eledengbao he searched the great forest to the end, beheaded the chief culprit Gou Wenrun, and remnant bandits were all pacified; he was restored to first-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he and Eledengbao cleared the great forest, killed Gou Wenrun, and regained first-class marquis.

sentences.zh: 十年，召授領侍衛內大臣，充方略館總裁，總理行營事務，管理兵部。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was summoned and made chief commandant of the imperial bodyguard, chief compiler of the Strategic Narrative Office, director of field headquarters, and director of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he became chief bodyguard commandant, headed the Strategic Narrative Office, and directed War.

sentences.zh: 十一年，寧陝鎮新兵陳達順、陳先倫等作亂，命馳往剿治。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year new troops of Ningshan garrison mutinied under Chen Dashun and Chen Xianlun; he was ordered to rush to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Ningshan new troops mutinied; he was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 叛將蒲大芳等乞降，縛獻達順等，磔之。

translations.literal: Mutinous officer Pu Dafang and others begged surrender, bound Dashun and others, and presented them; they were executed by dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Dafang bound Dashun and others; they were dismembered.

sentences.zh: 大芳等遣戍回疆。

translations.literal: Dafang and others were banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dafang and others were sent to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 議以降眾歸伍，詔斥寬縱，奪職。

translations.literal: It was proposed that surrendered masses return to the ranks; an edict rebuked leniency and stripped his office.
translations.idiomatic: A proposal to re-enlist mutineers brought rebuke and dismissal.

sentences.zh: 尋授西安將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed general at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 十三年，剿定瓦石坪叛匪。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he suppressed Waishiping rebel bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he pacified Waishiping rebels.

sentences.zh: 十四年，晉三等公。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was advanced to third-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he became third-class duke.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，柩至京師，帝親奠，御製詩輓之，諡壯果。

translations.literal: Soon he died; when the coffin reached the capital the Emperor mourned in person and composed an elegiac poem; he was given the posthumous title Zhuangguo.
translations.idiomatic: He died; the Emperor mourned in person and gave the posthumous name Zhuangguo.

sentences.zh: 詔四川建立專祠，入祀京師昭忠祠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a special shrine built in Sichuan and entry into the capital Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan built him a shrine and he entered the capital Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 德楞泰英勇超倫，戰必身先陷陣，名與額勒登保相亞。

translations.literal: Delengtai was surpassingly brave; in battle he always led the charge and his name ranked just below Eledengbao.
translations.idiomatic: Delengtai was extraordinarily brave, always first in the charge, second only to Eledengbao.

sentences.zh: 馬蹄岡之戰，轉敗為勝，時稱奇績。

translations.literal: At Matigang he turned defeat into victory—called a marvel at the time.
translations.idiomatic: Matigang, where he turned defeat into victory, was called a marvel.

sentences.zh: 既卒，奉詔褒卹，特舉是役保障川西數十萬生靈，厥功最偉。

translations.literal: After his death imperial commendation especially cited that campaign as preserving hundreds of thousands of lives in western Sichuan—his merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: After his death the court praised Matigang for saving hundreds of thousands in western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 在軍俘獲，必詳訊省釋，未嘗妄殺良民婦女，保全甚眾，蜀民尤感頌焉。

translations.literal: Captives in the army were always questioned in detail and released; he never killed common people or women wantonly and preserved very many—the people of Shu especially praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He questioned captives carefully, spared civilians and women, and won deep praise in Shu.

sentences.zh: 子蘇衝阿，一品廕生，授侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Suchong'a, a first-rank yin privilege student, was appointed bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Suchong'a, yin student of first rank, became a bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 每德楞泰戰勝，輒擢其官，累遷至盛京副都統，署黑龍江將軍，襲一等侯。

translations.literal: Whenever Delengtai won a battle his son's rank was raised; he was promoted repeatedly to deputy commander at Mukden, acted as general of Heilongjiang, and inherited the first-class marquisate.
translations.idiomatic: Each victory raised Suchong'a until he inherited the marquisate as Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 孫倭什訥，杭州將軍；

translations.literal: His grandson Woshine was general at Hangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Grandson Woshine became Hangzhou general;

sentences.zh: 曾孫希元，吉林將軍：並嗣爵。

translations.literal: great-grandson Xiyuan was general of Jilin: all succeeded to the title.
translations.idiomatic: great-grandson Xiyuan Jilin general—all inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 次孫花沙納，官至吏部尚書，自有傳。

translations.literal: Second grandson Huashana rose to minister of personnel and has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Second grandson Huashana became minister of personnel and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 論曰：仁宗親政，以三省久未定，卜於宮中，繇曰：「三人同心，乃奏膚功。」

translations.literal: The historians comment: When the Renzong Emperor took power in person, because the three provinces were long unsettled he divined in the palace; the oracle said, "When three men are of one heart, then skin-deep merit is achieved."
translations.idiomatic: The historians note: Early in Renzong's personal rule, with the three provinces still unsettled, he divined in the palace and received the line, "Three hearts in one—then the work is done."

sentences.zh: 後事平，敘勞：額勒登保第一，德楞泰次之，勒保又次之。

translations.literal: Later, when affairs were settled and merit was ranked, Eledengbao was first, Delengtai second, and Le Bao third.
translations.idiomatic: When peace came, merit was ranked: Eledengbao first, Delengtai second, Le Bao third.

sentences.zh: 論戰績，勒保未足與二人比，然當德楞泰偕明亮由楚入陝，見民苦虜掠，陳堅壁清野策，廷議以築堡重勞，未之許也；

translations.literal: Judging battle merit alone, Le Bao does not fully compare with the other two; yet when Delengtai with Mingliang entered Shaanxi from Hubei and saw the people's suffering from plunder, he proposed the fortified-village and cleared-countryside policy; court debate held that building forts would overburden the people and it was not approved;
translations.idiomatic: In pure fighting, Le Bao ranks below the other two; yet when Delengtai entered Shaanxi from Hubei he proposed stockades and cleared countryside, and the court refused as too burdensome;

sentences.zh: 勒保至四川，始力行之，推之三省，賊竟由是破滅。

translations.literal: when Le Bao reached Sichuan he began to enforce it vigorously, extended it through the three provinces, and the bandits were finally destroyed thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bao enforced it in Sichuan, spread it through three provinces, and the rebels were broken by it.

sentences.zh: 三人者相得益彰，未容有所優劣：勒保寬能容眾，額勒登保忠廉忘私，德楞泰仁及俘虜，識量並有過人。

translations.literal: The three men complemented one another and cannot be ranked above or below: Le Bao was magnanimous and could embrace the many, Eledengbao was loyal, incorruptible, and selfless, Delengtai was humane even to captives—their discernment and capacity all surpassed ordinary men.
translations.idiomatic: The three complemented one another: Le Bao was magnanimous, Eledengbao loyal and selfless, Delengtai humane even to captives—each surpassed ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 為國方、召，延世侯封，豈偶然哉！

translations.literal: To stand with the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao of old and receive enfeoffments lasting generations—was that accidental?
translations.idiomatic: To rank with the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao and win hereditary noble rank—was that chance?
